name: A life-and-death race on the highway #ContentInspirationSharingProgram #XiaoBaiT
description:
type: Video Browsing; caption: A life-and-death race on the highway #ContentInspirationSharingProgram #XiaoBaiTalksAboutTheWorld @KuaishouHotTopics(O40300129) @KuaishouFenTiao(O40300047) @KuaishouHost(O40300120) Content from the internet; ocr: Road traffic law education video, no negative influence! Do not imitate! A sedan lost control and raced wildly on the highway, with its speed fixed at 126 and unable to decelerate. Xie was driving when his cruise control malfunctioned. Despite trying every method he could think of, he was unable to control the speed, and the car kept racing forward at 126 km/h. His mental state was on the verge of collapse at this moment, and a fatal crash seemed to be only a matter of time. He originally wanted to call his wife for a final goodbye, but because it was late at night, his wife's phone kept going unanswered. In extreme panic, he called the highway traffic police. Before the police could even ask what happened, he couldn't wait to leave his last words with the officer: "Hello, I'm currently on the Jinghu Expressway, my speed is 126, but it seems my brakes have failed."

After understanding the general situation, the operator guided Xie not to hang up and to report his vehicle's location in real-time, as a major traffic accident could occur at any moment under such circumstances. The highway traffic police simultaneously activated a level-one response, contacted the command center to quickly initiate the emergency plan, dispatched all nearby patrol vehicles to pursue Xie's vehicle, contacted the road management units ahead of Xie's vehicle to clear slow-moving vehicles from the road, creating a life-saving corridor for Xie, and even activated all surveillance cameras on this road section to monitor the man's trajectory. In an instant, alternating flashing police lights illuminated the entire night sky, and urgent sirens echoed through the heavens.

However, the rescue progress was not satisfactory. The operator searched for various emergency solutions and instructed Xie to try them, but none had any effect. Meanwhile, the traffic police contacted the car manufacturer requesting an effective solution, but received no response. To ensure Xie's safety, highway traffic police from both Shaoxing and Taizhou had already initiated joint operations. A large number of police officers and auxiliary police were all on duty, driving dozens of police cars rushing onto the highway, imposing speed limits and controls on vehicles along the way, clearing a smooth lane, warning them to be careful and not to overtake. At the same time, all highway toll stations, parking areas, and service areas along the Sutai Expressway in the Taizhou direction were immediately closed, prohibiting any civilian vehicles from entering the highway.

At this moment, Xie's inner panic was beyond words. In his despair, he said something that brought tears to countless netizens' eyes: "Am I going to die?" The highway traffic police also brought good news—the good news was that after driving a few more kilometers, Xie would encounter responding police officers. But bad news followed immediately: the road ahead consisted of continuous tunnels, and there were a large number of slow-moving heavy trucks in the tunnels. The difficulty of passing through safely was self-evident. The operator's tone on the phone also became urgent, constantly encouraging the desperate Xie, "Ah, then you take care of yourself." He kept honking his horn all the way, alerting slow vehicles ahead to yield.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 49, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Plane crashes unexpectedly into forest, a series of mysterious events unfold #FastTalkMovieReview #NineBodiesInAMexicanMorgue #PopularityIncentiveProgram; ocr: "The Mexican Morgue." A girl discovered something strange while on a plane: despite having been airborne for quite some time, they were still flying over an endless expanse of primeval forest. Before she could ask the flight attendant when they would arrive, she unexpectedly heard a commotion outside the cabin, followed by the propeller stopping. At that moment, the captain in the cockpit was also in chaos—it turned out that due to GPS signal loss, the plane had long lost navigation and become like a headless fly, with fuel nearly exhausted. Seeing that their only hope—the radio—received no response, the desperate captain picked up his phone and began recording his last words: "Cordelia, my love, it's me." Then the plane began an uncontrolled dive. In panic, everyone grabbed their seats and prayed continuously, but fortunately the captain had served with Russian aviation—the plane not only successfully crash-landed, but the passenger cabin remained quite intact. People only suffered minor injuries with no major problems overall. However, a flight attendant who hadn't managed to sit down broke her neck during the violent turbulence. "Cervical fracture, there's no saving her." Afterward, everyone got up to check on the captain's condition. Upon opening the door, they discovered a tree branch impaled in his chest—clearly he was in critical condition. Just as several people were discussing how to rescue the captain, the previously damaged engine began emitting white smoke, then uncontrollably burst into flames. Smelling it, Awei immediately kicked open the cabin door, and seeing this, everyone followed to escape. The two in the cockpit couldn't worry about the captain's injuries either—they violently pulled out the branch stuck in his chest and rescued him. Meanwhile, Awei, who ran out first, didn't think about putting out the fire but hurriedly opened the luggage compartment to find his baggage. Fortunately, there was still a rational person on board—Anna grabbed a fire extinguisher and rushed over in time to put out the fire. Though she didn't understand what in Awei's suitcase could be so important, she had no time to think about it now. At this point, aside from the flight attendant who died in the crash, 9 people remained at the scene, all like headless flies not knowing where they were. There were no cell towers in the primeval forest, so naturally phones had no signal or GPS positioning. Even worse, the surroundings were unbearably hot, causing Fat Brother, who had suffered from serious illness, to cough incessantly. Seeing this, Fat Sister quickly picked up bottled water and handed it to her husband, but after just one sip he realized he must conserve resources. However, the optimistic Fat Sister believed the authorities must already know about this and might be on their way to rescue them. But some thought the complete opposite—Anna believed the rescue team would likely have difficulty finding this place in the short term, and they must first make thorough preparations. With that, she planned to first carry the flight attendant's body outside to prevent it from rotting in the stuffy environment and making everyone sick. Seeing this scene, the blonde girl fearfully buried her head in her boyfriend's arms. Soon after, she heard movement in the woods, but when she turned around she saw nothing—only falling leaves made the place seem quite eerie. At this time, Anna had already begun organizing the remaining supplies. Afraid she might hide some, Fat Sister quickly came over to supervise under the pretense of helping, but this made Anna resent her. At this moment, the captain finally awoke from unconsciousness. Strangely, his first words were to claim the crash wasn't his fault, and that he had called for help at the time, but seeing no response, he didn't know if anyone had received the distress call. Seeing him in great pain, Old Black quickly asked Glasses, who was a doctor, to help check his injuries. "Who told you I'm a doctor?" It turned out that when the flight attendant died, only Glasses had instinctively stated she died from cervical fracture—such professional terminology would typically only be known by doctors. Seeing this, Glasses had to admit he used to be a doctor, then began assessing the captain's injuries. Currently, he wasn't having body convulsions from internal bleeding, so the wound must have avoided vital areas. The only reason for his rapid breathing could be pneumothorax caused by lung compression. "Can you perform surgery?" "How is that possible? Pneumothorax might kill him, but operating under these non-sterile conditions—if he gets infected, he'll definitely die." Seemingly simple, but actually quite complex beneath the surface. You ready? Let's enter the crime scene together. Time: April 7, 2016. Location: Tongyi County, Baicheng City, Jilin Province. That morning, my second uncle came to the village scrap collection station to select farming tools for spring plowing, but after browsing for a long time, the station manager never came out. Puzzled, my second uncle went inside and found the station manager lying motionless on the kang bed. At first, my second uncle thought he was just sleeping, but no matter how much he tried to rouse him, the station manager had no response. Realizing something was seriously wrong, my second uncle quickly called the police. The criminal investigation team rushed to the crime scene. The deceased, Ning, ran a scrap collection station. According to the forensic preliminary examination, the time of death was between 11:30 AM and 1:30 PM on the day of the incident. The cause of death was mechanical asphyxiation, commonly known as strangulation. They found that the tendons in her neck had been severed. A woman wouldn't have the strength to break her own neck tendons - this was clearly a homicide. So in broad daylight, who would be so bold as to commit such a heinous crime in a public place? Based on the crime scene investigation, police discovered three suspicious points. First, the victim should have been alive before death. Second, the victim's clothes were neat, there was no blood at the scene, and no signs of struggle. Third, due to a layer of loose sand that had formed on the local ground, investigators found two shallow drag marks on this layer of sand, very obvious, like two feet scraping the ground while being dragged. These drag marks extended all the way to the dirt ground in the backyard, which should be the actual crime scene. Since there were also no signs of struggle here, police analyzed that the killer must have ambushed Ning, and Ning didn't even have time to react before being strangled to death by the killer. The suspect then dragged the body to the kang bed inside the house and tidied up the crime scene. All signs indicated that the suspect was experienced and likely had a criminal history, and his purpose in coming to the scrap collection station seemed to be specifically to kill Ning. So who had this 50-year-old woman offended? Suddenly, investigators discovered that the scrap collection station's yard actually had two surveillance cameras installed. As long as they could retrieve the surveillance footage, all problems would be solved. However, the progress bar tells us things obviously couldn't be that simple. Although they didn't find surveillance footage, the police weren't empty-handed. Based on the scene analysis, the suspect's methods were so practiced that he couldn't have failed to notice the surveillance cameras in the yard. According to enthusiastic informants, the victim's husband Fu was usually responsible for purchasing outside, while the victim Ning stayed home alone to watch the store. description: type: Video Browsing; ocr: The sheep shearing frame uses the flip structure S49P-TLY to shear various parts of the sheep. Why only shear the head and tail? If the sheep's head wool is too long, it easily collects grass debris, and shearing can also reduce insect bites and prevent bacterial growth.; asr: Watch carefully as the man is shearing these sheep. By flipping them over, he can get the sheep on their backs with all four legs in the air, then lock one of the hind legs in place. This way, it's convenient for the operator to shear various parts of the sheep's body while preventing the sheep from moving around wildly. Next, the man picks up the shearing tool and starts from the sheep's head. You'd think he would shear all the wool off the entire sheep, but the shearer only cleans up the facial wool on the sheep's head before turning to trim the wool on the tail. So why do they only shear the head and tail while leaving the wool in the middle? Actually, there's quite a bit of reasoning behind this. First, the head - if the sheep's head wool is too long, it will block their eyes, making it hard to find the right position when grazing with their head down, and they're more likely to bump into things when walking. Additionally, long head wool easily catches grass debris, and over time can harbor small insects. So by shearing the head clean, the sheep can see clearly to graze well and suffer less from insect bites. Second, the tail area - because the wool around the sheep's tail easily gets soiled with feces. These dirty substances, when stuck on for a long time, breed bacteria and can easily cause skin inflammation in sheep. So shearing the tail area clean can prevent sheep from getting sick due to dirty wool. However, after the old man struck it for a long time, there was no response. "Your broken machine can only tap little squirrels." After testing, it only took 150 seconds to harvest one pine tree. The neighbor thought the old man was definitely bragging. In the past, when he hired people to pick fruit, it not only cost seven or eight hundred yuan a day, but it also took at least twenty minutes to finish one tree. A reporter who loved making things happen brought six tree-climbing college students to compete against the machine in a man-versus-machine contest. Within an hour, whichever side picked the most pine cones would win. As soon as the competition started, the college students climbed trees and picked fruit bravely and smoothly in one go—clearly they did this often. However, at that moment, a violent earthquake-like tremor suddenly came. After asking, he learned that to prevent cows from getting injured while pulling things, they installed rollers at the bottom of the harness. This gave the old man a bold idea. Soon, the ultimate version of the Qilin Arm was created. First, sliding blocks were installed inside the mechanical hand to avoid damaging the trunk. Second, the vibration box's movement pattern was changed from all-around to back-and-forth. To test the safety of the third generation, the old man brought his son's goldfish tank. He planned to use the mechanical arm to lift it and shake it vigorously while ensuring the glass wouldn't break. The reporter thought this was impossible to achieve, but was shocked the next second. The water in the fish tank was shaken up and down by the old man, constantly spilling out, while the goldfish inside seemed to have experienced a massive tsunami. description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Beginners should not attempt this without instructor guidance. We still need to direct students' operations after demonstrating. Improper operation can lead to accidents! #Guangxi #Excavator Training #Excavator Education #Learn Something New With Me Every Day; ocr: Climbing slopes. Learning to operate excavators in Guangxi. When going uphill, try to use the foot pedals as much as possible. We don't use the grab - we can still move forward, which is equivalent to having someone pull you up from above with their hands. Use the boom cylinder for traveling. If you force it with the grab, you won't make it to the top. You must reach the top in one go, which means using the travel function.; asr: When going uphill, try to use the tracks as much as possible, because sometimes when you can't move forward, we need to coordinate hands and feet, using the tracks to walk directly. Right now it's not slipping, so we don't need to grab. Then, as we move forward it will rise up, and when it rises, we need to push the boom down. If you just keep moving, it will keep rising with you, and then the center of gravity will also tip backward. So we need to move while - you see, lower the boom a bit when it rises too high, keeping it about ten centimeters from the ground. Keep the center of gravity pressed forward at all times, moving while lowering, walking and stepping properly while moving and lowering. You see this slope is quite steep, but we can still traverse it. It won't flip as long as the center of gravity is in front. Move while lowering - you see when the boom lifts up, we lower the boom to press it down. Press it down. Now if walking feels a bit difficult or it's slipping, then we can grab a bit. Press the boom down to brace it. At this point, it's two movements: slow walking. Curl the stick in. Why curl the stick in? The reason is simple - it's equivalent to someone pulling you up from above with their hands. The stick assists, and at this point, walk slowly and curl the stick fully. However, when we curl the stick, it will lift the front - the tracks will lift up at the front end. So at this point we need to coordinate with the boom. Lower your boom, the tracks can't lift too high at the front. If the front lifts too high, once your boom leaves the ground it will easily slide down. The tracks must all be pressed against the slope surface. Then, how do we operate next? Walk and curl the stick. Watch the tracks lift at the front, we lift the boom to keep it against the slope surface. Okay, now to do this continuously: step on the tracks, curl the stick. See, the front is lifting. Lift a bit, release, lift a bit, release, lift a bit, release. Don't lift abruptly - if you lift abruptly, the bucket will separate. Keep the bucket engaged. You see, lift a bit, lower, lift a bit, lower. Okay, now we definitely can't reach the top in one go, the stick doesn't have enough reach. So at this point, we can't force it to grab. If we go over the top of the slope with the tracks suspended in air and lift the boom, there's a risk of flipping backward. So at this point, for safety, we can lower the dozer blade to brace ourselves. Brace it, then extend the stick forward, the farther the better. Extend it out, because the farther we extend, the longer we can grab, the safer it is. Okay, at this point, lift the blade up and brace it a little bit. But note, at this point you must make it to the top in one go, because our tracks are already at the top of the slope. If you can't make it to the top in one go, with the tracks suspended in air it's dangerous. Okay, then walk and step, curl the stick fully, do both movements fully. Okay, see the front is lifting, lift a bit, release, lift a bit, release. Okay, now at the back here, if you feel it's starting to dig into the soil - see how steep it is, it's digging a bit - then at the back here we need to lower the boom. It's not about rigidly lifting the boom - you need to watch the bucket. See, if it's not digging we don't need to lower, but if for example now it's digging, we need to lower the boom at the back to brace it, can't let it separate. Then when lowering the boom, add one more movement - add a bucket curl movement. Why curl the bucket? Because the bucket is a bit angled and digging into the soil, so if we curl the bucket out it won't dig. At this point it's: step on the tracks, curl the stick, lower the boom, curl the bucket - four movements together. You see, step on the tracks, curl the stick, lower the boom, curl the bucket. See, curl the bucket out to let it brace. Okay, now we're up enough, our tracks are already two-thirds up. At this point it's already safe, just slowly step on the tracks and slowly lift the boom down and it's OK.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 15, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

At noon, a woman who had just been laid off by her company packed up her belongings and prepared to go home. She came to the roadside and hailed a ride. After a while, the driver who accepted the order rushed over. As soon as the woman saw the car arrive, she hurried forward to open the trunk. But at this moment, the driver got out of the car and saw it was a young woman, so being chivalrous, he jogged over saying, "Let me help you with that. After saying this, the driver prepared to get in the car and very gentlemanly opened the rear door for the woman. Then he returned to the driver's seat ready to drive. The man, known as the world's foremost young master, showed no emotion facing an enemy army of 300,000. Seeing the enemy general charging forward with his gray blade, the man dodged and with a swift motion released a paper talisman, causing the general to instantly fall from his horse. Since the general was unwilling to grow taller, he would come himself. As an envoy, he sought an audience with the Shangzhou commander. Yu Wuyuan, of increasingly noble status, came alone to the border between the two armies to persuade the Shangzhou commander to withdraw troops and prevent devastation across the land. Currently, the six kingdoms of Great Eastern all harbored ulterior motives. Yet Shangzhou, with its middling strength, was the first to cause trouble. If it allied with the five states against them, Shangzhou would instantly collapse. To show his sincerity, Yu Wuyuan promised Commander Fan that as long as he withdrew his troops...

What seemed like a crisis resolved by Yu Wuyuan took an unexpected turn when the Shangzhou army returned. Yu Wuyuan immediately guessed the commander was no longer Fan Shuaikong - General Fan had been stripped of military authority. Indeed, as he suspected, right after Commander Fan left camp, a eunuch arrived bearing the emperor's direct orders. Seeing Fan's intention to withdraw, he had Fan Shiji bound and executed on the spot under the authority of the imperial gold medallion.

Subsequently, leading 300,000 troops, they surrounded Luochang again. Yu Wuyuan's original intention was peace, but given the circumstances, he had to fight. He ordered the army into three-row formation... However, Luocheng's forces of merely 3,000 against Shangzhou's 300,000 were like eggs against stone. Yet no one expected a black shadow to suddenly pierce through the army and seize the eunuch's throat. The newcomer was naturally Hei Fengxi, who reminded the eunuch that Jizhou's rebel forces were on their way. If the eunuch insisted on fighting, he would face enemies on both sides. Moreover, he had no talent for commanding troops. "Go tell the Empress Dowager that if she ignites this war, the first to be consumed by the flames will be herself. Some people are easily blinded by greed; I hope she remains clear-headed." The eunuch, already trembling with fear, dared not linger. Thus the crisis at Luocheng was finally resolved.

Yet no one knew that Fengxi Gongzi, one of the four great young masters, and Yongzhou's Second Prince Lanxi Gongzi were the same person. He deliberately pretended to be ill, living alone in the Hot Spring Palace thousands of miles away. But even so, his brother had no intention of sparing him, suspecting the one in the Hot Spring Palace was merely a body double...

description: type: Video Browsing; caption: #TributeToClassicHongKongFilms #ClassicFilmAppreciationClips #WatchedTheWholeMovieBecauseOfOneScene; ocr: Only Lisu and the three captured natives remained. He called out to Asen to throw him the corpse-suppressing talisman hanging from the tree, immediately hatching a wicked plan. Uncle Ying opened the canned food and devoured it heartily, only to see a great wildlife migration, which he worshipped as a deity protecting them. So he also stuck his leg into the snake hole, single-handedly securing several days' worth of food for the tribe. As long as it follows the will of heaven and makes sense, Lisu learned of the situation and hurried to find Uncle Ying to prevent him from being poisoned. I'm certain your ancestor must be within a hundred zhang radius.; asr: You've been dead for so long and you're still afraid of dying? You're so timid, how can you be someone's ancestor? Master, you can't step on my ancestor. Fine, I won't step on him, I'll kick him. The zombie jumped from the plane with a parachute alone, while Uncle Ying and Asen shared one parachute. The zombie happened to land right in front of Lisu. The invaders ordered someone to kill the zombie, but when the spear stabbed the zombie's body, it immediately broke in half, leaving everyone stunned. Lisu curiously looked at the zombie before him and tore off the talisman. The zombie instantly went berserk, chasing anyone it caught with tremendous strength and invulnerability to weapons. Everyone hid, and the zombie lost its target. Originally, if they just stayed put and waited, the zombie would leave once it couldn't find a target, but this foreigner just had to court death. He took advantage of the zombie's distraction and ran frantically toward the car. The zombie saw the living thing and immediately gave chase, causing others to suffer as well, getting severely injured by the hopping zombie. The invader drove away, leaving only Lisu and three others. They became the zombie's only target and could only run for their lives. They fled back to the tribe. Lisu looked at the yellow talisman in his hand thoughtfully - could this suppress the zombie? So he seized the opportunity and stuck it back on the zombie. The zombie indeed stopped, and he accidentally discovered that the bell on the rope could control the zombie's hopping. Lisu thought the bell belonged to the zombie and hung it on the zombie's hand. Meanwhile, Uncle Ying and Asen were still hanging in the tree. They finally got down from the tree only to encounter a lion. Uncle Ying thought that since the talisman could suppress corpses, it could surely suppress lions too, so he told Asen to throw him the talisman hanging in the tree. But Asen threw the bag containing the talisman right next to the lion's mouth. Uncle Ying could only pretend to have a gun to scare the lion. Hahaha. Ahhh. Ahhh help ahhh. No no. Asen led back a rhinoceros, and they quickly climbed up the tree, having to rest in the tree waiting for the rhino to leave. On the other side, Lisu saved a foreign woman. The foreign woman was also one of the invaders. When she saw the stone axe used by the natives, she got a bad idea and traded a mirror for Lisu's diamond. The diamond had no value in Lisu's eyes; instead, he thought the mirror was too precious and wanted to return it to the foreign woman, but she was in a hurry to leave and sped away. Uncle Ying and Asen spent the night, and a group of baboons stole their bag, scattering the canned food all over the ground. The baboons developed a strong interest in the cans. Uncle Ying thought that with the baboons' intelligence, they definitely couldn't open the cans, and once they got tired of playing, they would leave. Asen took out the remaining can, and Uncle Ying opened it and ate heartily. Unexpectedly, these baboons were quite intelligent and learned by example, opening all the cans. They ate what they wanted and threw the rest, not leaving a single can for Uncle Ying and them. Instead, they were attacked by the baboon group. Looking at the cans on the ground, Uncle Ying's heart was bleeding. The two decided to catch the zombie first. To fly high and see far, Uncle Ying grabbed onto an ostrich. He controlled the ostrich to run wildly, making Asen fly high into the air with the parachute on his back. But after looking for a long time, Asen only saw wild animals. Just then, that rhinoceros charged at them again. Uncle Ying quickly covered the ostrich's eyes with his hat, causing it to brake suddenly. Asen fell to the ground, and Asen also descended from the sky. The parachute covered them, allowing them to avoid the rhino's attack. Meanwhile, a group of African children were playing with the zombie using the bell. Lisu saw this and hurried to stop them, but made an accidental discovery - the zombie knocked down fruit from the roof. So he controlled the zombie to harvest lots of fruit. They believed the zombie was a gift from heaven and worshipped it as a guardian deity. Meanw

Liu Neng, Xie Guangkun, Wang Laoqi, and Zhao Si heard the broadcast and immediately went to the village committee for an important matter. Liu Neng, after hearing the broadcast, ran breathlessly to the supermarket, counted on his fingers, and bought four packs. Director Zhao Si thought it was a criticism meeting against him and set off nervously. Accountant Xu actually drove a tractor to the meeting and ran into Xie Guangkun on the road, offering him a ride, but was refused. "I won't take it. Your vehicle is a bit narrow. I'll take my own car." Unexpectedly, Xie Guangkun went to the bean products factory to find Xiao Meng to drive him to the village office for the meeting, but was stopped by Wang Laoqi. "You just got back from a trip and don't want to leave? Why have him drive you? This really won't work. I'll carry you on my back." After buying cigarettes, Liu Neng waited at the village office entrance. When Accountant Xu arrived, Liu Neng praised him profusely: "For seven yuan, you're the only one in our village who drives, and you're quite stylish lately." Then he gave him a pack of cigarettes. It turned out Liu Neng knew that today's meeting was to recommend village director candidates. Today with flowers and cigarettes, he was canvassing for votes. Then Liu Neng pulled Wang Laoqi aside and secretly slipped him a pack of cigarettes. On Zhao Si's side, Liu Neng was afraid he wanted to be village director himself, so after lecturing him, he generously gave him a pack of cigarettes too. "One smoke is enough, I'll give them all to you. I understand now, it's expensive. Go home quickly and check the video. I bought a Tesla on Guazi Used Cars for only 99,000. If you miss it, you'll lose big. Guazi used new energy source staff saves more money." On Guangkun's side, after entering the meeting hall, he put on airs again: "Oh my, the rural soil is really big. Wang Laoqi returned the cigarettes to Liu Neng and chose to abstain. Zhao Si ultimately didn't put his in-law first and chose to flee the scene. So now the most critical vote was in Accountant Xu's hands. Liu Neng gave him a light for his cigarette, hinting at him. Chang Gui suddenly had an uncomfortable throat and kept coughing. Finally, Accountant Xu drew a circle. Liu Neng took the paper and compared it with his head: "Isn't this writing about me?" But Accountant Xu said it represented abstention. So the final result was a tie. However, the director has the deciding power in a tie, so the candidate was Liu Yishui. Some families were happy, some were sad. Chang Gui and Xie Dajiao were pleased that their wishes were fulfilled. Guangkun was happy as long as Liu Neng didn't win, so only Liu Neng sighed over the four packs of cigarettes. But Liu Neng soon became happy again. He went to the supermarket to return the cigarettes, but Xie Dajiao disagreed. Anyway, when he bought them earlier, it was on credit, so Liu Neng put down the cigarettes and ran. "What are you doing?" Soon things took a turn. Today was the auspicious day for the office building relocation of Xiao Meng's bean products factory. Liu Neng heard the firecrackers and, as a prominent figure, had to join the excitement. On the road, he ran into Zhao Si pushing a cart of flowers, also heading to the scene. "Liu Ying is pregnant and holding a celebration, why didn't you bring flowers?" Then Liu Neng ran into Liu Yishui delivering flowers and got good news. Liu Yishui hadn't decided whether to take the village director position. Liu Neng's mind turned, and he seemed to see hope of becoming village director again, so he tried to persuade Liu Yishui that being village director was tiring and he shouldn't do it. But he was interrupted by Guangkun: "Our family's new building is completed. What are you wandering around here for? What business is it of yours? This belongs to Wang Xiaopeng. I say, why are you getting more confused as you age? Wang Xiaomeng married our Xie Yongqiang, so it's called the Xie-Wang family. This building has the Xie surname. Guangkun, be careful, don't remove that railing and fall down again." Then Liu Neng stopped Liu Yishui on the road again to continue his ideological work. The state has clear arrangements for this. This video shows you what it means to have iron discipline coexist with compassionate care. During service in our country's military, pregnancy among female soldiers is not uncommon, and the armed forces have long had clear and humane policies for this. Once pregnancy is discovered, the female soldier must immediately report to her superiors. Military hospitals will arrange comprehensive examinations to confirm the gestational week and assess maternal and infant health. The unit will then proactively adjust her position based on her physical condition and military specialty, arranging relatively lighter work such as clerical or logistics duties. If she is an air force pilot, artillery soldier, or other high-intensity special military occupation, training and duty are immediately suspended to fully ensure fetal safety. Special regulations also stipulate that no night shifts are arranged during pregnancy. Accommodation arrangements are more considerate—those whose families are local can return home to live, while those from other areas are arranged into comfortable and reassuring officer apartments. After the child is born, female soldiers legally enjoy maternity leave and nursing leave. After childbirth, they can decide whether to continue serving and adjust positions based on personal wishes, military needs, and physical recovery. However, please note that these caring policies mainly apply to married pregnancies that comply with regulations. Unmarried pregnancy is considered a serious violation of military discipline and will be subject to corresponding disciplinary action. Our country's military both resolutely protects the rights and health of every female soldier and strictly maintains military discipline and normal operations. Well, he's been at it again with new tricks lately. Previously, because his experiments were just too dangerous, his parents decisively stepped in and issued a ban, especially prohibiting any chemistry experiments. But this kid couldn't sit still without experiments to do. He turned around and became obsessed with home appliance repair. One day, when his parents came home from work and opened the door, they saw the TV completely disassembled with parts scattered all over the floor. Just as their blood pressure was rising and they were about to scold him, they discovered that this kid had quietly reassembled the TV perfectly, and it worked just fine. But that's not all - he even used his pocket money to secretly set up a proper little workshop, equipped with all kinds of professional tools, everything neatly organized. While his peers were still buried in video games and scrolling on their phones, this little guy had quietly become a small business owner. At first, he was a bit confused too, couldn't recognize all the parts and tools, so he practiced on his classmates' broken phones, carefully disassembling and studying them while watching tutorials. And guess what? In less than two hours, he actually fixed it. This learning and hands-on ability made many adults feel inferior. From then on, there was no stopping him. When he noticed his mom's phone constantly running out of storage and overheating severely, without a word, he expanded it from 128GB to 256GB. Later, the whole family's phones were handed over to him for maintenance and upgrades. His mom couldn't help but complain: "Other people's kids refuse to leave toy stores, mine spends all day at the hardware store." Indeed, interest is the best teacher. But the most impressive part is yet to come - this kid actually secretly taught himself programming and 3D modeling without his parents knowing. These things that give many college students headaches, he independently developed an electromagnetic gun in just two days using only a phone. Good heavens, this isn't an ordinary elementary school student - this is clearly a naturally gifted hands-on expert. First, the most annoying thing on rainy days is when water droplets cling to the rearview mirror, making vehicles behind you appear blurry, and you always feel anxious when changing lanes or turning. At this time, just cut a potato open and gently wipe it in a circle on the rearview mirror. You'll find that water droplets won't attach to it as easily, and the heavier the rain, the more obvious the effect—it's like a natural coating. Second, after driving for a long time, a layer of hazy oil film accumulates on the windshield, and wiping it several times with glass cleaner doesn't help much, seriously affecting visibility. This is when the potato comes in handy again. Cut a small piece and rub it back and forth on the glass, let it sit for a few minutes, then rinse it clean with water. You'll find the glass instantly becomes crystal clear, and your vision becomes transparent. Third, small metal parts in the car tend to rust over time. If you spray rust remover, you worry about its corrosiveness. Cut the potato open and rub it repeatedly on the rusted areas, then rinse with water. You'll find the rust can basically be cleaned off without damaging the parts. So don't underestimate this humble potato—at critical moments, it really comes through. type: Video Browsing; caption: A humble teacher changed the fate of a poor student, tears at the end! #QuickTalk #TheLegendofBanwanVillage #MovieReview; ocr: The Legend of Banwan Village. Teacher Xu was the only mathematics teacher in the village. Teacher Xu was ambitious and hoped to make some contribution to society. His careless remark was firmly remembered by Shuli, who raised his axe and struck at the forest he had guarded for half his life. It was also the first time he saw clearly the sharp edge of the word "poverty." Tears streamed down his cheeks—this too was the glory of the barren mountains.; asr: # Translation

Just eating two portions without any dishes, he gets his meal at the cafeteria and never orders vegetables. When classmates ask him, "Why don't you eat vegetables?" "I've been getting heatiness lately." A female classmate can't bear to watch and pours her beef and potatoes into his bowl. The boy's name is Yue Shuli, a child from the mountains. Because his family is poor and can't afford supplies, he hasn't turned in homework once in three years of school. "It's you again, three years of school and I've never seen you turn in math homework once." The teacher decides to test him. "Recite the Pythagorean theorem for me." "A squared plus B squared equals C squared, which means in a right triangle, the sum of the squares of the two legs equals the square of the hypotenuse." The teacher is shocked by his answer, realizing he has such a talented student. After school, he keeps Shuli behind, gives him a test paper to complete. In the time it takes to turn around, Shuli finishes it. Teacher Xu checks the answers - all correct. You should know, this is a middle school math competition paper. Without a doubt, Shuli is made for studying. Teacher Xu is the village's only math teacher. His wife is sloppy. At the movies, she only thinks about reading. At night when his wife turns off the lights to sleep, she still reads with a flashlight. The villagers say he'll never leave the mountains in his lifetime. He places his dreams on Shuli, determined to cultivate this promising student. He visits Shuli's home to understand the situation, only to find Shuli and his stepfather fighting.

It turns out Shuli had just come home from school to help his mother with farm work, only to discover bruises on his mother's forehead. He knew it was his stepfather's doing, so he went home to confront him. Teacher Xu explains his purpose and shows the test paper Shuli completed. "One hundred points!" "Yes, 100 points. This is the citywide math elite preliminary exam paper, and Shuli answered it." The principal decides to have Shuli represent the school in the city competition. Grandpa is thrilled and expresses his support, but Shuli is indifferent. Right now is the busiest time for farm work. To help lighten the family's burden, Shuli skips class to weed the fields. When Teacher Xu learns of this, he's furious and kicks him. "Let go!" Teacher Xu pulls out the math competition admission ticket, but Shuli doesn't take it, saying he still needs to weed. Just then, they encounter several truant students. Teacher Xu has them go home to get hoes to help Shuli weed together, freeing up more time for him to study. While working, Teacher Xu quizzes him: "What's the answer to that last question?"

From then on, whenever Teacher Xu gets a chance, he tutors Shuli. When neighbors in the village buy a TV and Shuli watches movies at night, Teacher Xu walks right over. "Hey, son, how come you're not doing your homework and you're here instead? Let's go, let's go. If you're so capable, why don't you buy a 34-inch TV yourself, or better yet, a 340-inch one!" Teacher Xu's offhand complaint lodges in Shuli's heart. He understands Teacher Xu's good intentions, and all he can do is repay him through studying. The impoverished mountains have poor transportation. To get Shuli to the city for the exam, Teacher Xu buys a pumpkin and begs a vendor to take them on his tricycle. Watching the mountains recede, Teacher Xu is full of ambition: "This time, win first place! As the old saying goes, 'Are kings, nobles, generals, and ministers born to their stations?'" Teacher Xu falls hard to the ground, but the roar of the tricycle drowns out his shouts. Helplessly, Teacher Xu can only wave for Shuli to go take the exam alone. Shuli rushes into the exam hall holding the pumpkin but is stopped.

"The exam has already started. Forty-five minutes - you're forty-five minutes late. According to regulations, anyone more than half an hour late cannot enter the exam room." "Go back." "But I haven't taken the test yet!" "Never mind, just a child from the mountains, forty-five minutes late." "But I haven't taken the test yet! A child from the mountains..." Children from the mountains face far more hardships than city children. Seeing Shuli's appearance still touches the dean's heart. She gives Shuli a test paper and personally proctors beside him. Whenever winter or summer vacation arrives, his miserable life begins. He married off three daughters, never expecting they would bring back ten grandchildren for him. Every holiday, the ten grandchildren come to grandfather's house in groups. Every New Year when giving out red envelopes, he gives until his hands go numb. Their daily living expenses are at least 500 yuan or more, and one summer vacation can consume his entire year's pension. Every day he's either cooking or on his way to cooking. Meals are like a cafeteria, going out is like military troops, and shopping is more like bandits. Every day there's also fighting over things. Not only are grandfather's pockets emptied, but he's tortured to the point of losing all will to live. Today let's take everyone into the hilarious daily videos of grandfather and his grandchildren. This old man is 77 years old this year, from Jieyang, Guangdong. The old man raised a total of four daughters and two sons. Back then, the old man said he liked the feeling of having children and grandchildren around his knees, so he encouraged his daughters to have children, offering a reward of 10,000 yuan for each child born. So the three married daughters directly brought back ten grandchildren for him. Adding the three children from his two sons' families, this old man has 13 grandchildren in total. The oldest grandson is already in college, while the youngest is still in diapers. Other elderly people have three highs, but this old man has three fears: fear of summer vacation, fear of winter vacation, and fear of New Year. Every holiday season, the ten grandchildren come rushing over in great numbers, and the old man's house completely becomes a children's den, just like devils entering a village to raid. Every meal and bath requires queuing. In an eight-hour day, the old man spends at least six hours cooking. The old man's cooking speed can never keep up with the grandchildren's eating speed. Before, buying groceries once could last three days; now buying three days' worth of groceries is only enough for one meal. Daily living expenses alone exceed 500 yuan; in less than 20 days, they eat through half a year of the old man's pension. Every trip to the supermarket empties his wallet. Every New Year, when the old man gives out red envelopes, his hands tremble. However, what troubles the old man most is that every day there are countless grandchildren, endless disputes to settle, and endless fights to break up. Seeing this lively big family, netizens all express their envy, but some netizens also say that if the old man were given another chance, he probably would never dare encourage his daughters to have children again. You owe her, so I don't want to owe you any favors. At this moment, you should go with the flow and guide her actions, while setting up your next meeting. Joke with her and test the waters to close the distance between you. "You're treating me like an alarm clock. But alarm clocks are kept by the bedside." "I think you're really gentle and very feminine." "I don't know." How to respond to this? Whenever you encounter this kind of question, it's a great opportunity to express interest. At this moment, one sentence turns passive into active - whether you're interested in her or not, now she's interested in you. You can joke and ask back: "Are you asking me this because you're interested in me?" "I have a good impression of you, what about you?" description: type: Video Browsing; caption: American classic TV series #fast-talking drama #heavy life #movie commentary #film and TV commentary; ocr: A heavy life. An unbelievable weight. Joey's obesity was congenital, his weight reaching as high as 792 pounds, but Joey had already clearly felt the changes in his body. Dr. Na told him he could improve through skin removal surgery, but this type of surgery carried greater risks than gastric bypass surgery. Joey quickly picked up the flowers and went forward to greet them.; asr: Harry Potter, weighing 800 pounds, fell down again. He could only call the firefighters once more, because he simply couldn't stand up by himself. This was already his tenth fall this month, and the firefighters were experienced by now. Ten strong men came directly and skillfully spread a white cloth under the fat man, then used all their strength to lift him onto a stretcher, and then sent him to the hospital. Fortunately, after examination, there was nothing seriously wrong, except that his joints could no longer bear his enormous body, which was why he kept falling frequently. This is not a movie, but a real documentary. The man is called Joey, living in a small town in Tennessee, USA. He has been imprisoned in this ugly shell for thirty-one years. Due to being too obese, he is ashamed to see people, so he chose to live alone. His greatest helper is this cane - walking requires the cane, picking things up requires the cane, turning off lights still requires the cane, but eating requires human help. His sister comes every day to bring him food and check if he's still alive. His mother loves him even more. Despite being ill herself, she always worries about Joey going hungry and buys lots of Joey's favorite fried chicken and hamburgers every night to bring over. Seeing Joey eating with relish makes her happy, but afterward she regrets it deeply. She knows this is harming Joey. Just like this, every day passes in contradiction. Joey's obesity is innate. Since childhood, he could eat a lot. At age five, his parents divorced, causing Joey to lose his father's love. His mother felt guilty toward him, so she was very indulgent about what he wanted to eat and how much. Food to Joey was like drugs - the more he ate, the more addicted he became, unable to quit at all, until he reached his current 800 pounds. The frequent falls over this past month made Joey feel fear for the first time. He was afraid he would never be able to stand up again. He also realized for the first time that he couldn't live so miserably like this, so for the first time he had the idea of losing weight. The man took off his clothes and looked at the sagging fat on his belly, feeling disgusted himself. When walking, the fat bounced like springs, trembling painfully all over his body. This man is the result of losing 200 pounds. Just a year ago, Joey weighed 792 pounds. Weight loss expert Dr. Nowzaradan gave him a full body examination and found that his organs were already beginning to fail, one step away from death. Weight loss was urgent, and the most effective method was gastric bypass surgery. But Joey was too overweight and simply didn't meet the surgical requirements. Dr. Nowzaradan told him to go home first and lose weight on his own, and only when his weight dropped to 650 pounds would surgery be possible. Then Dr. Nowzaradan specially sent a nutritionist to Joey's home to guide his diet. The nutritionist told Joey which foods he could eat and required his daily intake not to exceed 1,200 calories. Joey was also very disciplined, strictly controlling his diet. In one month's time, he successfully lost 71 pounds, which made him extremely happy. Dr. Nowzaradan also praised him and encouraged him to continue working hard, striving to reach 650 pounds next month. Although he had only lost 70 pounds, Joey already clearly felt changes in his body. He no longer fell when walking, and could even walk to the gym to exercise. This gave him more confidence. A month later, he weighed himself again - 652 pounds. He had indeed reached his goal. Dr. Nowzaradan kept his promise and immediately arranged the gastric bypass surgery for him. He cut away 90 percent of Joey's stomach to reduce food intake, and also shortened the length of his intestines to reduce food absorption. After two hours of struggle, the surgery was successfully completed, and Joey's post-operative recovery was also good. In one month, his weight dropped another 60 pounds. After another two months, it dropped another 60 pounds. At this point, he had lost nearly 200 pounds in total. Although the results were gratifying, the increasingly loose skin troubled Joey again. Walking was even more painful than when he weighed 800 pounds before. He found Dr. Nowzaradan again. The good news was that Dr. Nowzaradan told him he could remove this loose skin through skin removal surgery. The bad news was that his current weight still didn't meet the surgical requirements. He needed to lose another 100 poun

description: type: Video Browsing; caption: A young man's first day working at the imperial kitchen made him suspect the supervisor of embezzlement, because a single radish cost 160 taels of silver #FastTalkDrama #ManHanImperialFeast #FilmAndTVCommentary #ContentInspirationSharingPlan @KuaishouFilmAndTVCreator(O40300198) @KuaishouHotTopics(O40300129); ocr: A Manchu-Han Imperial Feast. How much does this dish cost? 160 taels of silver! How much? Who are you trying to fool? If you trust this humble servant, give me 5 qian of silver, and I'll buy you a cartload of vegetables and radishes. On the young man's first day in the palace as a cook, serving grapes to the Emperor, he realized that the head steward of the Imperial Kitchen was embezzling the Emperor's silver. The steward was charging 160 taels of silver for common vegetables and radishes that were dirt cheap outside. The vegetables were clearly worth only 5 qian of silver, yet he spent over 100 taels. This was obviously pocketing Your Majesty's silver. Emperor Kangxi also suspected something fishy was going on, so he questioned the steward: "How much silver does the Imperial Household Department allocate to you each month?" "9,276 taels are allocated each month." When Zhang Dongguan heard that 10,000 taels of silver were allocated each month, he was extremely shocked, thinking that the Emperor's allocation was far too much. "If you trust this humble servant, allocate 1,000 taels to me, and I will ensure that everyone in the palace, high and low, young and old, eats happily and comfortably." Although Kangxi knew something was amiss, he didn't have sufficient evidence yet, so he symbolically reprimanded both men, then fined each a year's salary before leaving. As soon as Zhang Dongguan came out, a young eunuch notified him to go to the Emperor's study. Kangxi brought out the Imperial Kitchen's account books for purchasing vegetables, but there were no problems on the surface. So Kangxi suspected they must be embezzling privately. "There's definitely a problem in this Imperial Kitchen. The vegetable prices they're reporting are too outrageous. Those vegetables simply wouldn't cost that much. They must be secretly pocketing who knows how much of Your silver." Kangxi then bestowed upon Dongguan a gold medallion, which allowed him free entry and exit from the palace, and ordered Zhang Dongguan to investigate this matter thoroughly. The Imperial Kitchen steward also reported this matter to his superior in corruption, Lord Sheng, the head steward of the Imperial Household Department. Zhang Dongguan would definitely go to the market to investigate vegetable prices, so he had the steward go to the market and instructed them to raise all the vegetable prices. At this time, Zhang Dongguan went to the market, but when he asked how much cabbage cost, the answer made his jaw drop: "You want cabbage? One tael and five qian per head." "Are you robbing people? A cabbage costs one tael and five qian per head!" One tael and five qian was equivalent to over 300 yuan in modern currency. Dongguan had never seen such outrageous cabbage prices in his life. He didn't believe it and turned to another stall to ask the price of cabbage, but the result was exactly the same: "One tael and five qian." "You're also selling for one tael and five qian? Why are you all asking such exorbitant prices?" But the vendor said if he thought it was too expensive, don't buy it. "Yesterday it was still selling for one tael and six qian." He still wouldn't give up. He asked about beans—one tael and two qian per jin. He asked about eggplant—eight qian each. Dongguan was so angry he was speechless. Then Dongguan went to a dried goods store and asked how much the wood ear mushrooms and scallops cost. "These wood ear mushrooms, 10 taels per jin. Dried scallops, 18 taels." "How much? Are you crazy? This is a dried goods store—do you think it's a jewelry shop?" Dongguan was immediately so angry he cursed and walked out. His asking prices everywhere without buying vegetables alarmed the market boss, who warned him not to cause trouble if he wasn't buying. Dongguan took the opportunity to question him: "Why are the prices in your market so expensive? And all the vegetable vendors seem to have agreed on the same prices—they're all exactly the same!" But the boss said the uniform pricing was deliberately set by him to prevent the various stalls from competing for business. "As for what you said about it being expensive, it's really not expensive at all. This is the capital, at the feet of the Son of Heaven, not like other poor remote areas." Now Dongguan was completely out of options and left cursing angrily. As soon as he left, the steward's subordinate arrived: "You little rascal, you dare to play along with us—not bad, you acted well!" "Ah, Eunuch Man, you flatter me, hehehe. The family in "Eye of Jinxi" reluctantly agreed to the relocation, not even wanting the things in their house.; asr: A son-in-law single-handedly ruined his father-in-law, turning him from a millionaire into a pauper. Not only did he successfully provoke the neighbors into revenge, but the house also became an uninhabited tourist attraction. It wasn't until people saw that National Highway 206 would rather take a detour than accommodate this ugly behavior that netizens finally understood the true meaning of "greed knows no bounds, like a snake trying to swallow an elephant, or drawing water with a bamboo basket—all in vain." The incident began when Jinxi County in Jiangxi Province was constructing a national highway. Many villagers became wealthy overnight through this demolition compensation, but one family refused to move no matter what. Staff members visited several times to negotiate, but to no avail. It wasn't until they offered 1.7 million yuan plus three housing construction permits—a massive compensation package—that the family reluctantly agreed to the demolition. However, just when everyone breathed a sigh of relief, they suddenly backed out. It turned out that the family's son-in-law, upon hearing that his mother-in-law's house was to be demolished, also wanted a piece of the pie. He visited repeatedly to persuade and brainwash the whole family, demanding the demolition compensation be raised to 5 million yuan. Although this son-in-law wasn't highly educated, he was full of confidence and even spent 80,000 to 90,000 yuan to hire a lawyer. Under his manipulation, the two elderly parents gave the demolition rights to their son-in-law. As long as he didn't sign, the demolition couldn't proceed. The only clear-headed person in the family was the daughter-in-law, but the son-in-law argued that the son gets a share and the daughter gets a share—his share belonged to his wife, while the daughter-in-law was an outsider with no say in the matter. Thus, the only clear-headed daughter-in-law was excluded. The family was smug, believing they had a sure win, convinced that the national highway wouldn't be rerouted and that the other party would eventually compromise. But this wishful thinking was doomed to fail. The staff, in anger, modified the plan and made National Highway 206 take a sharp turn, planning to pass on both sides of the house—similar to the "Haizhu Eye." The neighbors, who originally had no chance of demolition compensation, suddenly received this windfall fortune. But they weren't dazed by this pie falling into their mouths. These neighbors immediately climbed onto their roofs overnight to remove tiles, abandoning their belongings and moving out. Several neighboring households not only accepted the compensation without fuss but even tore off their roofs overnight and signed contracts, fearing the construction party would change their minds. Now the retaining wall has been built. This wall not only blocks the construction noise but also blocks this family's dream of becoming wealthy overnight. They could only watch helplessly as their neighbors' cozy homes turned into cold strings of numbers. Although this family became a laughingstock across the internet, it wasn't without benefits—at least the government successfully opened the road to traffic, the neighbors got revenge on the son-in-law and settled the bride price grudge, and the homeowner kept their house, which became a famous check-in spot known as the "Jinxi Eye."; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 125, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: True, is_fast_forward_play: True, is_backward_play: True, is_enlarge_play: False

After the performance ended, they scattered like candy wrappers in a crowd, never crossing paths again. description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Bought a floor that nobody wanted, which came with two basement levels. Watch how I transform it into over 10 different spaces! #renovation #lower duplex villa #space design #transformation; ocr: Space magician. Transformed the lower duplex space, creating over 10 different spaces, installed an elevator, and added ventilation atriums. Left a sunken garden next to the temporary office area, and there's even an indoor basketball court for the eldest son to practice. The upstairs was converted into a walk-in closet.; asr: I'm the one who didn't listen to advice and bought what nobody else wanted - a first-floor unit with a two-level basement and a large courtyard. When I bought it, relatives and friends kept asking me what I was thinking. What was I thinking? I wanted a home. A place where no one tells you what to do, where kids can jump around without worrying about the downstairs neighbors knocking on the door. Besides, this house came with a ridiculous amount of bonus space - nearly 100 square meters extra. Can you believe that? Just with this bonus space alone, I managed to create ten different areas. You won't believe it - let me show you around. First, check out the most bizarre thing - buying a house and getting a well. Bet you've never seen this before. When I lifted the manhole cover, that pool of black water nearly shocked me senseless. But I couldn't let it go to waste - after all, I paid good money for it. First, I pumped out the water and had the stones cleaned. Installed a lift, and boom - instant cellar for storing wine and miscellaneous items. Even thieves wouldn't be able to find it. And this wall - when I knocked it open, there was actually a hidden cavity inside. Free space that I couldn't pass up - I cleaned it up and turned it into a perfect maid's room. Then there's this ventilation shaft. I raised both sides and added railings in the middle to turn it into a laundry room - not wasting a single bit of space. And this skylight that came with the house is amazing. I converted the left side into a tea space. Reading books and drinking tea here - couldn't be more comfortable. The right side became a study for temporary work and kids' homework - plenty of room. In the middle, I created a Chinese-style area - this Chinese aesthetic atmosphere is absolutely perfect. The living room window was opened up and converted into a large horizontal hall, and I also made a tea room. Set up a tea table - super convenient for entertaining friends and chatting over tea. Next to it, I kept a sunken garden for planting flowers and plants - greenery everywhere really lifts your mood. Now look at the second basement level - I installed a spiral staircase at the lighting shaft, which I covered in detail in previous videos that got millions of views. If you're interested, you can go check it out. On this wall, I installed a basketball hoop for my older son to practice. The opposite wall was turned directly into a climbing wall so the kids can exercise and burn energy at home. This floor has a ceiling height of nearly five meters, so I added a steel structure mezzanine and doubled the area. Downstairs became a KTV plus cinema - we can sing karaoke and watch movies at home. Upstairs was converted into a cloakroom with amazing storage capacity. Just through all this demolition and renovation, I created nearly ten additional spaces. Tell me, was it worth it or not? Which space do you like best? name: Do you know what the difference is between one zoo and another zoo? #ContentInsp
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Do you know what the difference is between one zoo and another zoo? #ContentInspirationSharingPlan #Zoo #Bizarre #Outrageous; ocr: Zoo. Super exciting plot. Behind-the-scenes story. Animal lover admission ticket. Sitong Bozhe Printing Co., Ltd. 2001. Ticket price: Two yuan. ¥2.00. For a mere two-yuan ticket, they were unwilling to admit they had overfed the animals, adding an extra meal after the animals' regular feeding time. They released Ling Shuang first, followed by the lynx garden baby. After all, it was my first time seeing them, making it even better value for money.; asr: Animals in zoos with 200-yuan admission tickets are skin and bones, while animals in zoos with 2-yuan tickets are so fat they're wheezing. Panzhihua Zoo, as a national model pig-raising facility, would rather make excuses about limited space than admit they overfeed their animals. With tickets costing only 2 yuan, they spend 1.8 yuan on feeding each animal. When the animals eat too much, they ruthlessly raise prices during holidays. The animals behind the 3-yuan ticket are all plump and robust, especially the leopard famous for binge eating, whose kiwi-fruit-like figure resembles the police officer from Zootopia. When netizens joked about why Baobao was so fat, the keeper stubbornly insisted it wasn't fat but loose skin due to old age. Good grief, they'd rather say he's old than admit they overfed him. And look at these foxes - back in the day, King Zhou would have sent them away as actual foxes. The moon bear's logo has been deformed, and netizens now call it the Nike Bear. Even more outrageous is the camel inside, which has been fattened into a creamy pretty boy with thick hair. And the submarine-sized fish in the pond is truly something else. Fortunately, the zoo started preparing weight-loss plans for the animals to shed the professional pig-raising label, though it feels like this diet meal is just an extra feeding after their regular meals. In the end, while I oppose animal cruelty, the animals here really should skip a couple of meals. As for Xining Wild Animal Park, its employment threshold is incredibly high - put it this way, if you're not a first-class failure, you don't qualify. So let's look at failure number one, the snow leopard Lingshuang. After receiving rescue care at Xining, they planned to release it back into the wild and began rewilding training. Unexpectedly, this training would shatter the director's expectations. They released a two-month-old lamb for Lingshuang, who was initially scared but had no choice but to hunt due to hunger. Who would have thought it took 30 hours and still couldn't bite through the lamb's skin. Unable to eat meat, they had no choice but to bring Lingshuang back to the zoo, feeling fortunate they hadn't released a mother sheep, as it might have counterattacked and sent the snow leopard flying, creating a world record. So Lingling was admitted to the zoo with good food and drink. Next is the lynx, Garden Baby. Keep in mind that wild lynxes can hunt wolves and Tibetan foxes, but Garden Baby won't even eat rabbits, and even grooms them. This scene seems to say "bunnies are so cute, how can you eat bunnies?" So it also successfully got hired, after all, Xining Wild Animal Park's motto is "if you're not a failure, you don't get hired." Lingzhe, who was castrated, is a perfect example. Who knew that in the zoo field there would be natural breeding champions. Animals in other zoos fear loneliness and cold, but animals at Chimelong Zoo have multiple generations of offspring. Take our national treasure, the giant panda - they only go into heat once a year, and if in a bad mood, can stop pregnancy. Yet at Chimelong Wild Animal Park, they already have three generations living together, plus triplets. By the way, this is China's first zoo with panda triplets. Additionally, six koalas introduced from abroad in 2006 have multiplied exponentially in just a few years. Regular zoos put one koala per tree, but at Chimelong Zoo, they have to put three or four on branches. If this continues for a few more years, it'll be like Australia. The food is also pig-raising standard - after all, this is the first time I've seen penguins so fat their flippers won't close, and elephants so fat their necks have multiple folds. This has led to animal overflow at Chimelong Zoo. Those herds of giraffes taking shelter from rain look like an animal migration. So it's not that Kenya is unaffordable, but rather that Chimelong Zoo's animal migration offers better value for money.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 3, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

type: Video Browsing; caption: #Watched the entire series because of one clip #Fast-talking drama commentary #Good drama recommendation #I'm watching great dramas on Kuaishou; ocr: In that special era, even having gold bars couldn't get you grain, so the two could only go to the ghost market. Thus, Ma Renli decided to ask friends for help in selling them.; asr: # Translated Text

There's one missing, but there were nine more bars. One man was gone. The old man had hidden ten gold bars at home, but after the two of them dug three feet deep throughout the house, they only found one. Refusing to believe it, he jumped down and searched again himself, but still... Looking at the gold bar on the table, Ma Renli didn't know whether to cry or laugh. Strange, there were clearly ten, how did they only find one? Although he trusted Niu Dadan's character, out of caution, he still tested him with words. As soon as the words left his mouth, Niu Dadan exploded. "I..." Niu Dadan's reaction made him dismiss his suspicions, but the remaining nine...

Just as he was puzzled, Niu Dadan was thinking about how to exchange it for grain. Now the whole country was suffering from famine. With this gold bar, it would be enough to help the villagers get through the famine. However, during this political movement, privately buying and selling gold bars was a serious crime. How to exchange the gold bar for grain became a problem. Fortunately, Ma Renli had connections. He had a friend in the city who ran a jewelry shop, so Ma Renli decided to ask his friend for help.

Hearing this, Ma Renli was immediately stuck. Fortunately, his friend pointed him to a path, telling him to try his luck at the ghost market somewhere in the west of the city. Before leaving, his friend repeatedly warned him not to get caught by plainclothes police. Knowing the stakes...

So the two wandered around the ghost market for several days. After figuring out the general situation, they decided to quickly make the deal and leave. Seeing Niu Dadan's reckless manner, Ma Renli immediately became anxious. Asking so openly would definitely attract the attention of plainclothes police. But before Ma Renli could stop him, this rash fellow was already approached by a man in a leather jacket.

"Hey, where did this gold bar come from? It wasn't stolen or robbed, was it?" "We dug it up. We didn't do anything immoral." Ma Renli, not far away, saw the young man asking questions and worried he might be an undercover cop. He walked over and kicked Niu Dadan to interrupt their conversation. "Young man, why so many questions?"

"What else is there to ask? The bank has its price, we have ours. Don't you have peace of mind?" When the young man saw the sellers, he asked them to show the goods. Unexpectedly, Niu Dadan really wanted to take it out, but was kicked again by Ma Renli. "The goods? No way." Ma Renli said if they wanted to trade, the young man should come to the cathedral in the eastern suburbs that evening.

Back at the inn, the more Ma Renli thought about it, the more he felt the young man might be dangerous. He clamored to go home, but Niu Dadan thought... Since they were going to trade, they needed to plan an escape strategy. Ma Renli would keep watch, and if there was danger, he would immediately signal Niu Dadan—they agreed on a cat's meow.

That night, they arrived at the eastern suburbs cathedral. The young man was already waiting there. Niu Dadan walked over and asked him to show the money first. Unexpectedly, the young man stalled for time, asking Niu Dadan to smoke a cigarette first. Just then, Ma Renli gave the signal—the other party was indeed a plainclothes policeman. Niu Dadan ran, and other plainclothes officers lying in ambush immediately chased after him. Fortunately, Niu Dadan...

The two were badly frightened and decided to go home the next day. But when the next day came, Niu Dadan was still unwilling and prepared to try his luck again. Those who frequented Buddhist temples seemed to all be wealthy people. He decided to go in and try his luck—maybe a rich person lived inside. Ma Renli was timid and could only hide behind a tree to watch. However, at this time, Niu Dadan didn't know that the owner of this house was actually a general of the Republic...

After entering, Niu Dadan didn't rush to talk about selling the gold bar, but first asked the owner for something to eat. "Brother, our family also has rations. If I give it to you, we'll go hungry too." "Stop talking, quickly give me something to eat." "You wouldn't ask if you weren't starving." General Chang was very polite, not only personally serving tea to Niu Dadan but also telling him to sit on the sofa. Niu Dadan was flattered, worried about dirtying someone else's home, but General Chang said since...

Hearing this, he carefully sat down. Soon the nanny brought four large steamed buns to the table. Niu Dadan swallowed greedily—he hadn't seen white flour buns for most of his life. General Chang told him to eat freely. Al

His parents ran a small convenience store locally, and since the store's business was doing well, Bingbing was usually taken care of by his grandmother. But this peaceful life changed one day in 2013. On the day of the incident, because the store had a temporary power outage, after Bingbing's parents finished cleaning up, they hurried home, thinking they could spend time with their child. But unexpectedly, Dingding wasn't at home - he must have gone out to play. However, as it got to past 9 PM and the child still hadn't returned home, they started going door to door in the neighborhood asking around. However, even by the next evening, they still couldn't find any trace of the child. Just when everyone was almost in despair, an elderly man who was hunting wild rabbits said that a few hours earlier, they had seen a little boy in a wasteland. Upon hearing this, the couple immediately rushed over in the direction the old man pointed, their hearts burning with anxiety. After searching through the grass for quite a while, they finally found Bingbing. They saw Binbin covered in blood, lying on the ground motionless. The couple didn't have time to think much - they picked up the child and rushed to the nearest hospital. Upon arriving at the hospital, Dingbing kept covering his blood-red eyes, crying and shouting in pain. The doctor's preliminary judgment was that the child might have fallen and injured his head, which would affect his vision, so they quickly arranged for X-rays and CT scans. Bingbing's eyeballs were gone, and from the traces of the wounds, it looked like they had been forcibly gouged out by someone. At the same time, the police immediately rushed to the scene to investigate. However, the scene was in the wilderness and no useful evidence was left behind. The case immediately hit a deadlock. But considering the severity of this matter, the police decided to issue a reward announcement, offering 100,000 yuan, hoping someone could provide clues.
