name: What is eSIM? What to do when changing phones? Is it safe? #The era of SIM-card-
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: What is eSIM? What to do when changing phones? Is it safe? #The era of SIM-card-free phones is here #eSIM #Learn something new; ocr: Azhe's Perspective: The era of SIM-free phones has truly arrived. If the phone is directly integrated into the device's chip, what does the absence of a physical SIM card mean? This is a SIM card that just connected to the three major carriers. The three major carriers announced the launch of eSIM phone services. Beijing News Shell Finance (Reporter Wei Yingzi) On October 13, China Mobile and China Unicom announced that they have officially received approval to conduct commercial trials of eSIM phone operation services. Additionally, China Telecom's eSIM service has also officially launched. With the news of eSIM commercial trials, I knew someone would ask: What is eSIM? What about changing phones? Is it safe? Today, let me explain everything in plain language. eSIM is not a "card," but rather the traditional plastic SIM card directly embedded into the device chip, a small chip soldered onto the phone's motherboard. Both have the same core function—helping you connect to the carrier network and make/receive calls. Traditional SIM cards require removing the card slot, inserting the card, and worrying about losing or damaging it. With eSIM, you scan a QR code to download a configuration file, and the iPhone will share the EID with the carrier or provider to activate the eSIM. The iPhone may temporarily access the network to complete this operation, and activation takes just a few minutes. Think of it as a "digital ID card"—a traditional SIM is a removable physical ID card, while eSIM is an electronic ID card stored in your phone. What's different about eSIM phones? How great is the SIM-free era? Previously, when traveling abroad for business, you either endured expensive roaming fees or prepared a bunch of SIM cards. Now you can buy what type of plan online in advance? Choose the data plan type for your travel eSIM. Data only: No calls or texts, but you can still browse the web, get directions, and use other apps. Voice and data: Make/receive calls, send/receive messages, browse the web, get directions, and use other apps. Scan to activate your overseas eSIM plan, continue. Travel eSIM setup complete. GigSky eSIM is now available. iPhone will detect when you're abroad and remind you if you haven't activated this number yet. Done. When you land and turn on your phone, you have internet immediately—navigation and ride-hailing sorted in a second. Moreover, eSIM can store configuration files from multiple carriers, equivalent to having several numbers hidden in your phone. Work and personal numbers can be easily switched with simple settings. Removing the card slot saves considerable space—manufacturers can either make phones thinner or expand battery capacity for longer battery life, and without the card slot opening, phones have better water resistance. The 5 questions everyone cares about most: 1. Can old phones use eSIM? No, eSIM is hardware soldered onto the motherboard. Old phones don't have this chip; you can only switch to a new phone that supports eSIM. 2. Is this thing reliable? If the phone is lost, can the eSIM be stolen? No need to worry about security—eSIM uses high-level encryption technology, more secure than traditional SIM cards. Even if the phone is lost, you can remotely disable it to prevent personal information leakage and financial loss, much faster than replacing a physical card. 3. How do you migrate eSIM when changing phones? Very simple. Between iPhones, you can connect to the same Wi-Fi to transfer eSIM (iOS 16 and above), or transfer eSIM through the carrier's app or website. 4. What are the requirements for getting eSIM? Be at least 18 years old, have no more than 5 phone numbers under your name and no outstanding payments, and you can apply online. 5. Can phones bought abroad be used domestically? No, foreign version phones don't have domestic security certificates and can't download domestic carrier eSIM data; they can only use roaming. Only domestic versions support domestic eSIM. You can even download local plans when abroad. It's not a new thing—smartwatches, tablets, and laptops have already adopted eSIM solutions; the technology is very mature. Even the tiny SIM card is becoming history, from the large SIM cards of the past to Nano-SIM, and now to eSIM. Communication tools keep evolving. The arrival of the SIM-free era not only makes using phones more convenient but also returns "network usage rights" to us. Previously, phones were tied to cards; now cards follow people, allowing us to choose suitable networks wherever we are. Finally, we can say goodbye to the SIM ejector tool. Are you ready to embrace the SIM-free era?; asr: The era of SIM-free phones is really coming. What does it mean if phones don't have physical SIM cards? I just saw news that the three major carriers have simultaneously launched commercial trials of eSIM for phone

description: type: Video Browsing; ocr: (Kuaishou) Online Micro-drama Filing Number (2025) No. 101192. My grandfather defended our country and participated in the War to Resist U.S. Aggression and Aid Korea, and was buried in a foreign land. The next day, Mom didn't have time to collect her emotions. Hello, Commander-in-Chief.; asr: My father defended our country at the border, my mother died on duty in Wuhan, my brother's police badge was retired. With nowhere to turn, I knelt at the gate of the military compound holding an iron box filled with my family's military seals and medals, crying out in grief and anger, "I'm giving these souls back to you. Now give me back my family!" Suddenly, a group of men in military uniforms rushed toward me in a panic. I vaguely recognized the leader's hand from my father's funeral. Back then, my father sacrificed himself to save him. After that trip to the border, he never came back. I lost my father forever. Tears fell heavily on the box. My mother went to Wuhan on a mission a few years ago. When the mission ended, she too died at her beloved post. My brother was killed by criminals. My God, the door split open. My gaze fell on a tarnished medal. What's the story behind this medal? My grandfather fought in the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea. I had to find my advisor to seek justice for myself. "Teacher Cheng, Zhou Ya and the others have been bullying me. Today they even beat me up like this." "It's normal for students to fight. Teachers can't really control that." "What about my financial aid? My financial aid is still mine, right?" "I forgot to notify you. Zhou Xiang needs that financial aid more than you do." A surge of anger rushed to my head. I felt my entire worldview shatter. "But I'm an orphan. Without financial aid, how am I supposed to survive?" "You being an orphan doesn't matter. The policy doesn't say financial aid must go to orphans. I've always been fair and just. My students would never bully others." "You'll get your karma!" "With that kind of attitude, I'll report you. You can forget about applying for student loans in the future." I was thrown out of the office. The necklace on my chest suddenly broke. Looking at the bullet casing, I seemed to see my father's weathered face. "Back then, your grandfather fought in the War to Resist US Aggression and Aid Korea and died heroically. His remains were never found. This bullet casing was picked up from the battlefield by your grandfather's comrade. It's the last bullet your grandfather fired defending our country. It accompanied your father through so many victorious battles. Today, your father is giving you this good luck charm to bless our baby to grow up healthy and live a happy life." But my father returned wrapped in the national flag, covered with red flowers. I clutched the bullet casing tightly in my hand, crying uncontrollably. "Father, are you sad for me too? Father, I don't want you to win battles anymore. Can you come back?" "Child, reasoning with him is useless. Let's go find the dean." Hope rekindled in my heart. Teacher Su explained the whole situation to the principal. "Teacher Su, I understand. You can go now." After watching Teacher Su leave, he asked me, "You say Zhou stripped your face. Do you have evidence?" In my memory, my mother was always crying. The last time I saw her was at my brother's memorial service. My brother lay in the coffin wrapped in the national flag. My mother cried her heart out. The next day, before she could recover emotionally, she went to the Wuhan frontline. When she came back, she had become a certificate for an anti-epidemic hero. All they left me was that iron box full of military seals. What use are these things? I couldn't understand. When I returned to the dormitory building, Zhou Ya and the others had thrown all my belongings into a fire. When I saw the iron box in the center of the flames, I went crazy and grabbed it with my bare hands, holding it tightly in my arms. Without a word, I carried the box and walked out. My mother once said these medals were our family's pride, the highest honor. But I don't want this honor anymore. Now I just want to know if these things can bring back my family. I recounted everything that happened. "These beasts dare to bully even a martyr's orphan. Do they think we're all dead? Today, even if I have to take off this uniform, I'll get justice for you." That day, the military district's phones were nearly blown up, contacting major military districts to have them claim their martyrs' families. "We will definitely give you a satisfactory result." At that moment, an old man arrived. Upon seeing him, everyone stood at attention and saluted in unison.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 4, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

description: type: Video Browsing; ocr: The era of SIM-card-free mobile phones is accelerating. China Mobile, China Unicom, and China Telecom have all launched eSIM mobile phone services, with hundreds of thousands of people having made reservations. Netizens joke: "The SIM card ejector tool we've been looking for years can finally be retired." With the full return of eSIM, which is directly embedded in the device chip, setup can be completed by scanning a QR code or entering an activation code through Over-The-Air (OTA) technology. Smaller in size and allowing free switching between carriers, it will bring more convenience to our lives. Currently, Apple iPhones already support eSIM.; asr: Is the era of SIM-card-free phones coming? eSIM is making a full comeback to phones, saying goodbye to the anxiety of inserting cards. It is reported that China Unicom, China Mobile, and China Telecom have all received approval to conduct commercial trials of eSIM phone operator services. eSIM phone services are officially on sale in 31 provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities across the country, but the highly anticipated Chinese version of iPhone Air still hasn't been released. So what is an eSIM card? Simply put, it's an electronic card directly embedded in the device's chip that doesn't need to be inserted or removed like a regular SIM card, and can be activated and used through remote technology. Just scan a QR code or enter an activation code to get it done. Compared to regular SIM cards, eSIM cards have no physical card slot, are smaller in size, allow free switching between operators, and provide more internal space. This gives phone components like batteries and cameras more room, and also improves water resistance. Currently, Apple iPhone 12 supports eSIM, and eSIM phones from domestic manufacturers like Huawei and OPPO are also about to hit the market. I originally thought this was just an ordinary video complaining about a manufacturer, but when the pandemic glass replication came, the plot twist was completely unexpected. Recently, I came across a video where a guy said he found a glass factory to custom-make tempered glass. He even attached his own design drawing and repeatedly emphasized to follow the drawing exactly. The factory, adhering to the principle of customer first, completely replicated the product one-to-one according to the blueprint. However, when the buyer received the goods, he exploded and posted a video online criticizing the glass factory, saying "Your head must have been caught in a door, look at this residual ash here." The two pieces of glass were crooked and twisted - no one's window frame in reality would look like this. Just as netizens were preparing to attack the factory, the factory directly threw out the buyer's custom drawing. Looking closely at the blueprint, there wasn't a single problem - it was made exactly according to the drawing. No one could argue otherwise. The evidence was solid. The master craftsman who received the drawing probably cursed even more harshly than the seller. But the old master looked at the drawing, silently lit three cigarettes, and said one thing: "If there's work, we do it." Although the glass factory didn't quite understand, they respected that the buyer must have had his reasons for saying this. Even if they lost money on this order, it didn't matter - just to build their reputation and show off their skills. Perhaps the person who drew the blueprint wasn't rigorous enough, but the craftsmen who made it were absolutely rigorous. But having said that, from ordering to cutting to edge grinding, not a single department thought something was wrong. Absolutely couldn't hold it together. The glass factory controlled the details to perfection. Anyway, in this case I'm on the glass factory's side, because there's no room left to stand on the consumer's side. You treated the glass factory like a small workshop, and the glass factory treated you like a designer. Even Brother Chen had to exclaim after seeing this, "This is what you call professional." We have to give their technology and service a thumbs up. This order wasn't for making money, just for showing off their skills. Whether the work is serious or not, let's not even talk about it - the technique is flawless. Even peers in the glass-making industry came out to support the factory. I believe this glass factory, whether in terms of technology or details, has achieved perfection and should be commended.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 4, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

Last year when we opened up the engine, we found slight wear on the block, so we replaced the head gasket, resurfaced the cylinder head and installed it. This car's got some years on it - we knew it wouldn't last too long, but didn't expect it to be this soon. Once bitten, twice shy. description: type: Video Browsing; ocr: The excavator wheel hub is fractured, and the disc has become integrated with the axle head.; asr: The excavator wheel is decisively broken like this, yet they still dare to bring it in for repair. If this were in China, you would have already been beaten by the repair shop owner. Fortunately, this is Pakistan, a country where everything can be repaired. The Pakistani master told me this is just a minor problem, it can be fixed for only 2,000 rupees, and comes with a six-month warranty. For this kind of torn fracture surface, glue definitely won't work because the fracture surface is shattered, and direct welding won't meet the strength requirements either. But the master already had a repair plan in mind - simply embed this round disc into the broken hub, then hollow out the middle. Then splice the axle head onto it to complete the repair. With the repair plan ready, the master first fixed the axle head on the faceplate, using a homemade dial indicator to find the center point of the axle head. After ensuring the center point was correct, he could machine the torn fracture surface flat. The master's task was to turn the axle head into a proper step, so it could be better spliced together with the round disc later. To ensure the machining dimensions were accurate, the master had to stop from time to time to measure, to avoid over-machining. Once the transition dimensions met the splicing requirements, the axle head was finished. Next, he began processing the round disc for splicing. The master first measured the dimensions needed for cutting the disc, and marked the limit line with a compass. Since the middle of the disc needed to be hollowed out, to speed up the repair progress, the master chose acetylene cutting. Although acetylene cutting leaves a lot of burrs on the end face, as long as sufficient allowance is reserved, it can be machined smooth later. After hollowing out the middle of the disc, it could then be spliced onto the axle head, but the irregular end face still affected the connection between the two. So the master had to fix it on the lathe faceplate to machine and trim the hole position, and the hole dimension was the outer diameter reserved on the axle head. To ensure dimensional accuracy, the master stopped from time to time to measure and compare, ensuring the two could better integrate when spliced together. After the inner hole dimensions met the splicing requirements, since the disc's end face wasn't flat enough, the master needed to machine it smooth. Only when every small detail is done well can the spliced hub be more solid. After the disc was machined, it could be spliced together with the axle head. Since the master's machining precision was very high, a hydraulic press with powerful downward pressure was needed to combine the two together. After pressing, the disc and axle head had formed a whole. Since the disc's end face wasn't flat enough either, the master needed to fix it on the faceplate again, using a threading tool to machine the end face smooth. After the end face was machined, the outer edge of the disc still needed to be spliced with the hub, so the outer circle also needed to be machined smooth. To make the spliced hub more secure, the master also needed to machine threads on the outer circle. Through the tight engagement of threads, the stability of the joint could be greatly enhanced. After the threads were machined, since the hub material wasn't suitable for direct welding, the master also needed to install bolts at the joint. To distribute the stress positions, the master marked four points at the joint between the axle head and the disc, then used a drill press to drill holes at the marked positions. After the holes were drilled, a tap was used to thread the holes. After all holes were threaded, bolts could be used to fix them together. The bolts ensured tight connection at the joint, avoiding loosening during high-speed rotation. After cutting and grinding the protruding bolts flat, the axle head processing was complete. Next, the hub could be processed. The master fixed it on the faceplate, using a boring tool to machine the hole position, and the inner diameter of the hole was the outer circle dimension of the disc. Since the disc already had external threads reserved, corresponding internal threads needed to be machined in the hub, so they could engage with the disc's threads. Under the master's skilled operation, the hub had been machined with internal threads. After the thread machining was complete, the master installed the axle head into the hub for a preliminary fit check. After confirming everything was correct, holes still needed to be drilled at the joint. The joint was also reinforced with bolts, so this step was similar to the previous one. I won't elaborate too much here. After grinding the protruding bolts flat, this broken hub was repaired. This is truly amazing - kudos to the Pakistani master's superb craftsmanship.; actions: type: watch,

Normally, we resuscitate for half an hour, and if there's no response, we consider giving up. The doctor advised the man to accept reality, saying that the golden window for resuscitation had passed and continuing would be futile. The son felt his vision go dark and nearly collapsed. He screamed hoarsely for his mother. After shouting for a while with no response, he quickly pulled out his phone as if remembering something. The doctor continued urging him to accept reality, saying there was no indication for further resuscitation, but he refused to believe what was happening before his eyes. What no one expected was that a miracle actually occurred - the little grandson's repeated calls actually brought the old woman back. Everyone present was shocked. Could this be the power of family bonds? The man told the doctor that his young son was the old woman's most beloved and most worried-about grandson. Although the old woman had miraculously come back to life, the family now faced a difficult situation. "After all, resuscitation went on for over half an hour, which means the brain experienced ischemia and hypoxia. Prolonged oxygen deprivation damages brain function, so we definitely recommend..." The doctor told him that the heart had stopped for over half an hour, causing severe oxygen deprivation damage to the brain and all organs. Her vital signs were unstable and she needed immediate transfer to intensive care for observation and treatment. But this meant high daily costs. The man fell silent. The hospital could immediately arrange for his mother to enter the ICU, but the most pressing problem was where the money would come from. The doctor estimated the first phase would cost 100,000 yuan, averaging 10,000 yuan per day for just ten days, and couldn't give a definite answer about what would happen after that. He explained his situation to the doctor, hoping for some flexibility. "Right now my child also has problems. I have to take care of the child full-time. It's just me relying on... the child's mother supports this family. My health isn't good, so I'm the only one with the physical ability. I have to take him to institutions for training. How much does that cost per month? 8,000 yuan there. The key issue is that a patient like this could cost 10,000 yuan per day. 100,000 yuan is already extremely difficult for this family." His younger son was suspected of having autism, forcing him to quit his job to provide full-time care at home, costing 8,000 yuan per month. Now the entire family's expenses depended on his wife's salary alone. Thinking about how he was already 44 years old but couldn't come up with a single penny at this critical moment, he couldn't help but cry. After comprehensive consideration, the doctor could only help within the scope of his responsibilities.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 3, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

Although our village committee doesn't have direct authority to take action, we will report to the police station right away. When they penalize you, don't come crying to the village secretary. We need to prevent fires every year, but this year the fire prevention pressure is relatively less severe. Don't be hasty though. We'll wait for a day with good weather, then organize people to supervise before we burn. Especially those near the Dahongyuan area and our third section - absolutely do not burn first without our organization. If you burn on your own and cause an irreversible situation, which happens every year, can you bear the responsibility? No. If you say you can bear it, then go ahead and burn. Opening it, he saw the supermodel Clara. "This is my wife? She's so beautiful." "Fate has brought us together again." Such a beautiful wife must cost money. B Chao immediately figured out his motive for kidnapping the tycoon - he probably wanted to make a big score to keep his wife beautiful and living in luxury. Since it was for his wife, what was there to hesitate about? "Killers and arsonists wear gold, while those who build roads and bridges save up." Now that he was a fugitive, he had to act like one. B Chao planned to first steal a tank of gas. Fugitives have no shame, no face, no manners, so he wasn't afraid. When the attendant came to collect payment, B Chao just made something up: "Missing you is like the most beautiful cloud in the sky, spring has come again to wander..." "Hey, you big guy coming out to get gas without even bringing money - what are you doing here, being poor?" "It's no use even if you kneel down. Do you still have any left? What's the matter, is it pure or not?" "Grade 92 really doesn't have the mileage of 95." Society had advanced, and the rules of the streets had changed. B Chao felt he couldn't be so arrogant anymore - it was easy to get beaten up. So he quickly ran to a pharmacy. But his bold way of taking medicine shocked the doctor. "Why are you taking medicine like that? Let me get you some digestive tablets." B Chao poured the whole bottle into his mouth, but after swallowing, he discovered the doctor had given him the wrong medicine - effervescent tablets. To prevent B Chao from dying in the store, the doctor quickly tried to collect payment. "WeChat Pay? Alipay?" After overdosing on medication, B Chao's IQ indeed surged. He quickly found out about the tycoon's movements. Seeing him leave with two beautiful women in a car, B Chao steadily followed behind. Although it was a bit hard on his pants, his tracking was on point. He just didn't expect this tycoon to come to the film studio in the middle of the night. After stealing some clothes, B Chao successfully infiltrated. He was surprisingly familiar with the place - he must have scouted it many times. description: type: Video Browsing; caption: When is a baby most clingy? This answer will bring tears to your eyes... #ParentingMustRead #ParentingExperienceSharing #ClingyBaby #MomEmotionalResonance; ocr: When is a baby most clingy? This answer will make your eyes well up with tears. Even though they're so sleepy they can barely keep their eyes open, their little hand still clutches your finger tightly. You just go to the balcony to collect the laundry, yet they cry at the doorway as if it's a life-or-death separation. Until one day you discover they can independently complete a complex puzzle, and only then do you suddenly realize that age when you were their entire world has passed.; asr: When babies are most clingy—this answer will make your eyes well up with tears. Those days and nights together from ages one to three, what you thought was merely the hardship of parenting was actually a limited-time gift that life bestowed upon you. You crouch down, and he wobbles into your arms. You pretend to cry, and he eagerly wipes your tears with his little hands. Even though he's so tired he can barely keep his eyes open, he still clutches your finger tightly. You just go to the balcony to collect the laundry, yet he cries at the doorway as if it were a matter of life and death. These moments of being needed to the point of suffocation later became luxuries you could never return to. Until one day you discover he can independently complete complex puzzles, gets up by himself after falling and patting his knees, and starts hiding little secrets in his diary. After school, the first hand he holds is no longer yours—only then do you realize that the age when you were his entire world had quietly come to an end on some ordinary dusk.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 1, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

When he came home and saw the paper cups stacked in front of him, he asked his wife what was going on. His wife softly told him that this was a trap their daughter had spent a long time setting up. Dad instantly understood the intention. So he went out and came back in again. At that moment, their daughter came out. Dad pretended not to see it when entering and tripped over it. The daughter was very happy to see her trap succeed. She probably won't understand until she grows up - how could small paper cups trip a towering dad? There's another dad who came home from work to find mom and son playing a game pretending to be a rooster and a dinosaur, wanting to give dad a surprise when he walked in. But when dad came in and saw them, he didn't say anything and went straight into the bedroom. Mom and son thought dad found it childish and didn't want to join in. What they didn't expect was that dad went to the bedroom to change into a big dinosaur costume. The living room echoed with laughter and joy. At that moment, the child's childhood happiness was completely fulfilled. There was also a family of three on the highway when the child suddenly wanted to eat flattened bread. Without a word, dad drove straight into the nearest service area and used the car wheel to flatten the bread, while mom recorded the beautiful moment on the side. description:
type: Video Browsing; caption: I have prepared my passport and obtained my visa to go to the Milan Motorcycle Show to share my embarrassment with motorcycle enthusiasts from around the world. I believe life should know no borders, and should be respected in every corner of the world. I will carry my half Bridgestone tire from my BMW motorcycle on my back. Playing at increased speed. However, regarding BMW headquarters, I also reported this situation to our warranty staff, and he said that motorcycle tires are not covered under the manufacturer's warranty. I thought, well, this tire has to be replaced anyway. Let me check where there's stock and how much it costs. But BMW headquarters doesn't supply this motorcycle tire, and our dealership can't order it. How am I supposed to ride it? You can't ride without wheels. August 9th 17:18. Regarding BMW motorcycles in August, I personally believe that life should not be divided by national borders.; asr: I purchased a brand new BMW 1300GS ADV motorcycle for 300,000 RMB on August 9, 2025. After riding only 800+ kilometers, I discovered serious quality issues with the tire after just a few hours of use. At the time, I was at the BMW 4S dealership in Harbin and requested warranty coverage and replacement. Their response was that BMW motorcycle tires have no warranty. The Harbin BMW 4S store told me: "Hello, I've seen the tire's condition and reported it to our warranty department. They said motorcycle tires are not covered under the manufacturer's warranty." I said, "Well, this tire needs to be replaced anyway. Let me check where there's stock and how much it costs." But BMW doesn't supply tires for motorcycles. "Okay brother, are you picking up the car today? If so, I'll prepare the keys, vehicle, and exit permit, inform security, and what time will you come?" "Girl, how am I supposed to ride the motorcycle? Can it even be ridden without a wheel?" I had serious doubts - a BMW motorcycle at a BMW 4S store, and they won't honor the warranty or sell me a wheel. How can I leave? A motorcycle can't run without wheels. Vehicles don't have a regeneration system like a gecko's tail. A motorcycle has two wheels total - how can it run with one broken? With no other option, I had to pay out of pocket to find a tow truck to transport the motorcycle from Harbin, Heilongjiang to Huludao, Liaoning. I posted videos about this incident, and BMW personnel saw them and contacted me to handle the issue. But every communication focused on my most basic problem - the issue of not providing after-sales tires, the vehicle being unable to run, and having to use a tow truck. Listen carefully - after the incident escalated, people normally tow vehicles TO the 4S store, but I was towing FROM the 4S store to my home. In subsequent communications, BMW proposed requiring third-party inspection. Even if you don't understand cars, don't you understand people? With things escalated to that point, would I dare hand the tire over to them? Let them take it themselves for third-party inspection? They could easily pin any charge on me and I'd be done for. Crystal clear.

On August 13, I contacted a third-party tire inspection agency in Guangdong myself and began shipping the vehicle from Liaoning to Guangdong. I also drove from Liaoning to Guangdong myself. After arriving in Guangzhou, as the video went viral, the third party saw this vehicle's incident and told me the remaining tire remnants couldn't be inspected. I contacted other third-party tire inspection agencies, but they all seemed to know about this incident and no one was willing to do the inspection. But people have hearts. Although they didn't do the inspection, every single person on site believed this tire had serious quality problems and defects. After refusing to inspect for me, BMW Motorrad issued a notice to 4S stores nationwide in August that from now on, BMW motorcycle tires would be covered under the three guarantees quality policy. On August 21, they communicated with me again and paid me 9,120 RMB for the motorcycle's shipping costs during this incident. On August 22, Guangzhou BMW store came to service me on-site. Because the motorcycle had no wheel and couldn't be ridden, they replaced the tire for me, changing from the original Elephant brand to Michelin tires. Under mutual agreement, we secured evidence - split the original tire in half, with BMW taking one half for inspection. From that day until now, it's been 69 days since they took the tire, and they still haven't responded about whether the tire quality is acceptable. Today is October 29.

An important point here is that in the 1300 ADV's global sales, other countries are equipped with Michelin tires, while those sold here are equipped with our domestic Elephant brand tires. This bike's actual maximum

The two people at daggers drawn before us can be said to be the right and left hands of billionaire Xiao Ran. As Xiao Ran's old classmate and romantic rival, Liu Yuan was originally the manager of Shenzhen's most luxurious Paradise Nightclub. The reason Xiao Ran parachuted in Qiang Zai to monitor him was because he made a wrong move. I'm afraid he'll suffer without the ability. Seeing Xiao Ran commit the mistake that successful men make, Liu Yuan couldn't help but worry. He was concerned that Xiao Ran would become too inflated after getting rich, and also worried that Han Ling, the girl from their university days, would ultimately be let down by Xiao Ran. But now she is Xiao Ran's subordinate and no longer has the right to speak with her as an equal, so she invited their mutual friend Chen Qiming to help persuade Xiao Ran. At this moment, Xiao Ran was reading palms with TV host Wei Yuan in a private room. After Liu Yuan knocked, she barged straight in. Xiao Ran immediately introduced Qiming to Wei Yuan as his university classmate. Wei Yuan, very perceptive, indicated she would leave first, but Xiao Ran stopped her. "Let her come in." But Liu Yuan didn't move, staring fixedly at the two. Seeing this, Wei Yuan immediately understood and again indicated she would step out. "It's okay, you stay for now." Seeing that Xiao Ran insisted on keeping Wei Yuan, Liu Yuan's expression had already turned cold. She looked at Wei Yuan with an unfriendly expression. Seeing the undercurrent between the two, Wei Yuan could no longer sit still. At this point, Liu Yuan's behavior had already made Xiao Ran's heart... If Chen Qiming were a bit smarter, he would have changed his approach. Liu Yan looked at Liu Yun with a stern face. Liu Yuan telling Chen Qiming all his private matters made him feel betrayed, but since all three were old classmates, he didn't want to tear their relationship apart. "Not a small matter, is it? A small misunderstanding wouldn't mean you don't even go back for her birthday. I also heard you not only didn't go back, but were with that young girl who just left." Hearing such a direct question, Liu Yuan immediately signaled him to stop. At this moment, Xiao Ran was secretly furious. He said he had an appointment with a client and got up to leave directly. "I haven't finished talking yet." As soon as Xiao Ran left, Liu Yan immediately launched into bombardment mode against his teammate, accusing Chen Qiming of not knowing how to talk after being married too long, and betraying him as soon as he opened his mouth. "I betrayed you? What are you afraid of? What's our relationship? We're classmates, and the relationship between classmates and comrades is greater than that between lovers." For Chen Qiming who couldn't grasp the situation, Liu Yuan had quite a headache. Chen Qiming obviously didn't understand that with the changes in their respective positions, their relationship was no longer what it once was. Liu Yan knew he had angered Xiao Ran this time, but at this point, there was nothing he could do. On the other side, after leaving Paradise Nightclub, Xiao Ran immediately contacted Qiang Zai, whom he currently trusted most, telling him to come to Paradise tomorrow as he had arrangements. Then he called Wei Yuan. The long night always requires finding something to do, such as continuing to read palms. The next day, Qiang Zai arrived as agreed. Their friendship of over ten years gradually moved toward complete rupture from this moment. name: This mother's response about the bride price is remarkably clear-headed #interes
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: This mother's response about the bride price is remarkably clear-headed #interesting knowledge gained; ocr: This mother's response about the bride price is remarkably clear-headed. If the groom's family wants the daughter to bring the bride price back, it makes me even more convinced that your family has financial problems. What's your view on bride prices?; asr: This mother's response about the bride price. She said just one sentence, yet it resonated with countless parents: "If you don't want to pay a bride price, then find a girl who doesn't require one. Don't waste my daughter's time. My daughter spent money while at my home, and now she's entering your home. What's wrong with me asking for a bride price?" She's simply reminding the groom's side that the bride price isn't an insult, but rather a manifestation of the man's sense of responsibility. As for whether she'll let her daughter bring the bride price back, she said whether or not she'll have her daughter return the bride price depends on two things: your financial situation, and your attitude when giving the bride price. If you're already thinking about getting it back the moment you hand it over, then sorry, I won't. Why does she insist on not returning the bride price immediately after marriage? She explained it very clearly - the bride price serves two purposes. First, if the young couple faces hardship in the future, this money can be used for emergencies. Second, if the marriage falls apart, at least her daughter has a financial cushion. She doesn't value the money itself; it's about giving her daughter a sense of security. If you're thinking about taking back the bride price as soon as you get married, that's a transaction. Why does she say the more eager you are to get the bride price back, the less comfortable she feels letting her daughter marry into your family? If her daughter insists on marrying, then all the hardships she endures and debts she bears are her own decisions. This mother spoke very directly: marriage is not a business deal, the bride price is not a ransom. It's a responsibility, a sense of security, and also a foundation given to her daughter. What are your views on bride prices?; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 18, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

In the end, the black car affected other vehicles' normal travel when changing lanes, causing the accident and bearing full responsibility, and was penalized according to law. Only after going to the hospital for a checkup did she learn that it was a skin glycation reaction caused by excessive sugar intake. The so-called "glycated face" refers to a phenomenon where, after long-term consumption of high-sugar and high-fat foods, excess sugar in the body undergoes a glycation reaction with collagen in the skin. A boy was just picking up scrap at a junkyard when suddenly the ground beneath him collapsed. His father tried to rescue him, but it seemed too late as the boy slid toward the abyss at an alarming speed. Fortunately, at the critical moment, a mechanical arm hooked him. After his father pulled him up, he carefully brushed away the dirt and discovered this was actually a complete robot. The boy was instantly thrilled, knowing that in today's world, robots had replaced boxing sports. Audiences were no longer satisfied with flesh-and-blood combat but were obsessed with mecha battles. Max grew up in this environment and naturally wanted his own robot, but his family's financial situation was limited. Today, however, he stumbled upon one at the junkyard. Extremely excited, he quickly cleared away the surrounding dirt. After digging all night, he finally unearthed the robot. Back home, Max rushed to start it up, never expecting that a robot buried in the junkyard for so long could still function normally. What surprised Max even more was that this robot had a rare imitation function. Even his father was amazed. Then his girlfriend equipped the robot with a remote control and showed him how to operate it—easy for Max who often played video games.

He then brought Adam to his father, wanting him to enter robot competitions, but his father refused outright because Adam was a second-generation sparring robot designed to take hits. Having him fight in the ring would be laughable. But Max disagreed with his father's view. He felt Adam wasn't an ordinary robot—he seemed to understand what he said and possessed some hidden potential.

So he approached his father again, begging him to arrange a match. Faced with his son's persistent pleading, his father compromised and took him to a friend's boxing gym to show him what real fighting robots were like, hoping he'd back down. There, Max saw Zeus, the world's most powerful robot, who could finish opponents with a single move. But this didn't deter Max; instead, it strengthened his resolve to have Adam compete. Faced with his son's stubbornness, his father took him to an underground boxing venue where he found a relatively weak opponent.

If Adam won, they'd get $1,000, but if he lost, Adam would belong to the organizers. Soon the venue filled with people eagerly anticipating the match. The opponent taunted them, but Max paid no attention, carefully adjusting his equipment. His father wanted to control Adam himself, but Max insisted this was his robot and didn't need his control. As the referee rang the bell, the match officially began. The opponent immediately stepped on Adam's foot and landed a punch to his head. Adam had no ability to fight back, and Max started to panic. Fortunately, his father was there giving instructions. But rebellious Max wasn't grateful, saying he didn't need help. Without his father's guidance, Adam fell into a disadvantage again, being pressed against the wall and pummeled. First-time competitor Max was flustered, not knowing how to operate the robot. Luckily, Adam was a sparring robot built to take punishment, showing no malfunction despite several heavy hits.

But just taking beatings wasn't a solution. With only thirty seconds left, this made Wolverine very anxious. The organizer's rule was that if you weren't knocked down within the time limit, you'd win. At that moment, Adam was knocked to the ground. The crowd erupted as the countdown began and the match neared its end. Max refused to give up, desperately shouting Adam's name. Under his continuous calls, Adam seemed to hear the summons and suddenly stood up. His father couldn't believe they'd won the match—this was the magic of boxing. They won $1,000, but the opponent was unsatisfied and demanded a rematch. The father wanted to take the money and leave, but his son agreed without hesitation.

The rebellious son left his father helpless. As the bell rang, the match began again. Learning from experience, Adam successfully dodged the attack. Before the opponent could recover, Max controlled Adam to deliver a fatal blow, successfully crashing the opponent's system, who frantically smashed his own head before collapsing. Everyone was incredulous that this robot had won. The opponent was furious but honored the bet, giving them $3,000. As they left, an agent approached the father and son, inviting them to another boxing match where they could win $7,000. That night, Max didn't sleep but researched Adam's hardware upgrades, working from night to day.

Now he needed exciting music. As the boy moved, the robot imitated him, movements perfectly synchronized without deviation. Thus a dancing robot was born. Soon the noise woke his father, but seeing them play made him very pleased.

type: Video Browsing; caption: Variety Show #Music @I Want to Trend (O1907752910) @Kuaishou Music (O40300011) @Kuaishou Hotspot (O40300129); ocr: The Siping police officer went from not understanding his father to becoming a father himself, and his story moved everyone present. The song "Father" was extremely beautiful. It was actually quite an ordinary morning. Dong Zheng graduated from the Performance Department of the Central Academy of Drama and pushed the car with us in the snow, so it was only at that moment.; asr: # Translation

Hello everyone, my name is Dong Zheng. I'm from the Siping City Public Security Bureau in Jilin Province. I'm an ordinary auxiliary police officer. Thank you all. In short, I should be the most famous police officer in Siping, right? Well, now my fame is definitely not the greatest—this fame isn't the greatest. You have many fans online. Uh, yes, there are quite a few fans, over 10 million. I've even watched Dong Zheng's works myself. Some works, including promotional content and legal education, are indeed very vivid. I think legal education should be more down-to-earth. When I first watched the works you filmed, my first reaction was that this must have been shot by a professional team. When I later learned about Dong Zheng's college major, I suddenly understood why the police station's productions were so professional and funny. Dong Zheng graduated from the Performance Department of the Central Academy of Drama, right? Yes, that's right. So this should be uncommon. Generally, to become a people's police officer, one usually graduates from a police academy. Yes, but actually when I was young—not young, but younger—I really studied performance. Since childhood, I've had feelings about police. How should I put it? I was somewhat resistant. How do I explain this? Because my father was a police officer, and he always stood me up and deceived me when I was little. I can somewhat understand what you mean. You mentioned having so much misunderstanding about your father's work as a child. How did you later become a people's police officer? It was because of an accident. That was, um, April 25, 2011. It was actually a pretty ordinary morning. My dad was making me breakfast at home. He was making my favorite poached eggs, the kind that's a bit red. Then my dad left. In less than half an hour, I received a phone call from my dad's colleague at work. He said, "Dong Zheng, I'm your dad's colleague. Your dad is not doing well. Come to the police station quickly." My father passed away from a heart attack. Did your father have such symptoms before? Yes, some. Every time he came home, he would have a very strong smell of nitroglycerin pills on him. But he never mentioned it. I never said anything. Never said anything. Later, what did the doctor say? Was this related to his usual long-term work pressure and irregular lifestyle? Yes, because my father was a grassroots police officer. Basically, when busy, on-duty police officers work 24-hour shifts continuously. My father was one year away from completing thirty years of service when he passed away, and one year away from retirement. He was relatively old. So there was one more year before your dad could retire with honor, right? Yes, actually, many police officers fall in this last year. This last step is particularly difficult to cross. My father passed away on April 25. When he died, I was at Beishan in Siping—a place like Beijing's Babaoshan. I was keeping vigil there. Suddenly the door was pushed open, and a group of sanitation workers came in. I was puzzled and asked what they were doing—sweeping, cleaning, or what? I said there's no need to sweep. They said, "We're sanitation workers from your dad's jurisdiction. You may not know much about your dad as a police officer. Your dad is the most un-police-like police officer I've ever seen." They said in summer, your dad would take a broom and sweep the streets with us. In winter, he would push carts with us in the snow. After hearing what they said about my dad as a police officer, my impression of police officers completely changed 180 degrees. Before he went to the police station, he was a traffic police officer who never issued fines. People rushing to take someone to the train station or hospital—it was almost always such situations. My dad never fined them. More often, he would tell them what harm their actions could cause. The police on screen and the police around me in life were all very imposing, resolute, and brave. So why was my dad's way of being a police officer like this? So I had a lot of misunderstanding about my father. Right after my father passed away, in May 2011, our unit, the Siping City Public Security Bureau, was recruiting civilian auxiliary police. So I thought at the time, I must figure out why my dad was so busy, why he was so busy that he gave his life. Could I be that kind of police officer? So after you went, did you find it was the same as you imagined? Completely different. Af

description: type: Video Browsing; caption: #Driving God Keeps You Safe All the Way #Truck Tribe; ocr: Life is never easy. A loud bang, and this trip is wasted again. I'm worried this screw won't hold tight, bro. Driving normally on the highway, I heard a loud "bang." If I'm not mistaken, the tire blew out again. Better get out and check. Liberation truck, after turning on the hazard lights, I saw no cars behind me, so I quickly got out. Didn't even have time to put on my outer pants and cotton coat. There are snow-capped mountains nearby. Let me get out first to see if it's a tire issue. Sure enough, the inner tire blew out. The sound came from this side. Eagle Tour first class, better get back in the car quickly. Either call for roadside assistance or check how many kilometers to the next service area. If it's close, I'll just drive slowly forward. After getting back in, I saw the service area was still five or six kilometers away. Alright then, no need to call for assistance. Who knows how much that would cost. Prices aren't high to begin with, so whatever I can save for the return trip... Can't make money in Yanchi either. Don't dare drive fast, about 30 mph, hazard lights on, staying in the emergency lane. After a few kilometers, entered the service area. Liberation truck, how could the tire blow out with just this little cargo? What exactly caused it? Besides, these tires are all pretty new, no old tires. We've already arrived at the service area, then parked the car at the repair shop entrance, preparing to change the tire. I put on my pants because it's not warm outside. Need to wear thin cotton pants, or my thighs will freeze when I get out. Put on jeans, feeling frustrated. Must put on the cotton coat before getting out. Looked around and saw no one here. Called the phone number, and they told me they're working at the other service area. Not many cars here now, just one mechanic left. He said I'd have to wait twenty or thirty minutes. I said okay, let me eat first then. Took the leftover food I packed from the restaurant yesterday and warmed up rice in the car. Because the inverter in the car can't power both the electric wok and rice cooker at the same time. Some people ask me why I order two or three dishes for one meal as a driver, so extravagant. It's not extravagance—it's because I can't finish it all, so I can take it to the car to heat up and eat. It's convenient, and restaurant takeout is cheaper than service area food, tastes good too. All packed from Northeast restaurants. Just swallowed a mouthful of rice, hadn't finished yet, and the young man came over. I'll eat after the tire is changed. Must watch from below because I'm afraid the mechanic will be careless and the screws will come loose again. He doesn't have a tire here, but I have a spare in my car. I said, bro, can you help me take it off and put it on? How much does changing a tire cost? Can't even eat properly now, getting somewhat upset. I said forget it, I'm not eating anymore. Let me wash the bowl. It's really cold now, my hands are frozen stiff just washing two bowls. By now, the guy has taken the tire off. After taking it off, I saw there were still stones on the wheel, so I used small pliers to pick out the stones, then he installed it for me. This old gal wants to ask everyone, should the new spare tire be installed on the inside or outside? Is he installing it right? He put the old tire on the inside. Guess how much this old gal spent changing the tire at this service area? No wait, I said that wrong.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 46, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

description: type: Video Browsing; caption: One sentence brought a conscientious manufacturer back to life #RuianIronWok #NeverExpected; ocr: Ruian iron wok, one sentence brought the manufacturer back to life. Sourced from the internet, no negative influence intended. So the blogger thought about buying an identical one, and even alerted the local market supervision bureau in the process. In the end, they won't be treated unfairly.; asr: Who would have thought that a simple question "Is the manufacturer of this pot still around?" could bring a company that had been shut down for years back to life. It all started when a blogger posted a video sharing how their family had been using a Rui'an Five Star iron wok for twenty to thirty years - it never stuck and never rusted, making daily cooking and cleaning completely hassle-free. The only issue was that the bottom was now wearing through, so the blogger wanted to buy an identical replacement. However, after searching many places without finding the same model, they turned to netizens for help, asking if anyone knew where to buy one. Once the video was posted, this high-quality iron wok immediately attracted a large crowd of onlookers, all asking for purchase links. Eventually, a sharp-eyed netizen used the patent number on the pot to trace its origin back to Wenzhou Rui'an. With help from local authorities, they actually managed to find the factory owner. Unfortunately, this model had been discontinued back in 2010 due to poor sales, and the reason for its poor sales was precisely because it was too durable. When netizens heard this, they weren't having it and kept urging the owner to resume production. This even caught the attention of the local Market Supervision Bureau. Upon hearing the news, they didn't hesitate and immediately decided to help the owner restart production of this heirloom-quality iron wok. Just like that, this conscientious company from years ago was brought back to life. The factory reopened, the owner dug out the old blueprints and restarted the production line. The iron woks are currently in production. It just goes to show that those who make products with genuine sincerity will ultimately not be shortchanged.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 18, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: False, is_backward_play: False, is_enlarge_play: False

name: How to handle a water pump getting caught in the TBM during tunneling, can the c
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: How to handle a water pump getting caught in the TBM during tunneling, can the cutterhead shred it #tunnel #megaproject #infrastructurepowerhouse; ocr: Tsinghua Garden Tunnel. Metro Line 10 overcame difficulties and controlled the subway line settlement to within 1 millimeter, ultimately resulting in this iron lump appearing directly in front of the machine.; asr: The shield tunneling machine unexpectedly churned up a water pump during excavation—this was a real incident encountered during the construction of the Qinghuayuan Tunnel for the Beijing-Zhangjiakou High-Speed Railway. The Qinghuayuan Tunnel not only had to pass beneath seven major urban roads including Xueyuan South Road and the North Third Ring Road, as well as 88 important municipal pipelines, but also had to run parallel to or cross the subway lines 10, 12, 13, and 15 for long distances. Moreover, the excavation diameter of the Qinghuayuan Tunnel reached 12.64 meters, making it the largest tunnel diameter in the history of northern engineering construction. The larger the excavation diameter, the greater the disturbance to the ground layers. Take subway line 10 for example—the minimum distance between the Qinghuayuan Tunnel and it was only 1.5 meters. Therefore, engineers had to control the settlement of the subway line caused by tunnel excavation to within one millimeter; otherwise, excessive settlement would seriously affect the subway's operating speed. This meant the tunnel had to be excavated with extremely high precision, like a sniper cutting a thread at a hundred meters away, and it had to be done in one shot without any margin for error. To ensure absolute safety, engineers first inserted steel pipes into the soil layer between the Qinghuayuan Tunnel and the intersection section with subway line 10, while simultaneously injecting cement slurry to solidify this section of ground. They also installed fully automatic monitoring points on the tracks of line 10 to constantly monitor the actual deformation of the tunnel and surrounding structures. On June 10, 2018, as the last subway train passed, the shield machine began slowly advancing toward subway line 10, with plans to complete the crossing before the morning subway service began. Although thorough plans had been made in advance, various unexpected situations still arose during actual construction. When the shield machine excavated directly beneath the subway line, the cutterhead suddenly emitted a piercing noise. According to construction regulations, once the machine produces abnormal sounds, construction should immediately stop; otherwise, it could lead to damage to the shield machine worth tens of millions. However, the shield machine's stopping position was extremely awkward—right beneath subway line 10. Once pressure was released, it would cause unpredictable accidents. So construction personnel quickly entered the cutterhead to investigate and discovered it was a water pump left over from the construction of subway line 10. Because this was a busy transportation hub area, precise surveys could not be conducted before construction, ultimately leading to this iron lump appearing directly in front of the machine. After developing an emergency response plan, the engineers decided to restart the shield machine's advance. They had to prepare an emergency plan, but this decision carried enormous risk. If the water pump jammed the cutterhead, the entire shield would be completely stuck beneath the subway. However, time waits for no one—no matter how difficult, they had to continue. As the piercing sound grew louder and louder, the advance distance also gradually increased bit by bit. After thirty minutes of advancement, the friction sound became smaller and smaller, meaning the shield machine had ground up the water pump ahead. Although the crossing took an hour longer than originally planned, it safely passed beneath subway line 10, and testing showed the actual settlement was only 0.7 millimeters—less than the width of a human hair.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 130, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: False, is_fast_forward_play: True, is_backward_play: True, is_enlarge_play: False

This nearly two-meter-tall giant had just arrived in the small town when he saw a street thug beating his wife. "What the hell are you looking at? I'm talking to you, idiot." The big man stood motionless, his neck as thick as his head—his physique alone was enough to intimidate the other party on the spot. "Listen, buddy, I'm just in a bad mood. It won't happen again." Seeing the thug bow his head in apology, Jack walked into the diner satisfied. He then ordered a black coffee and peach pie. He thought he could have a quiet breakfast, but before he could get the peach pie to his mouth, a police car pulled up outside, and the officers even pulled out shotguns—clearly something big had happened in this small town. Jack first looked at an elderly couple in the shop, then at two children at the counter, and immediately realized the police were coming for him. So he pulled out a bill to pay, then placed both hands flat on the table, quietly waiting for the police to arrive. "Police! Don't move!" The officers approached him cautiously with their shotguns. Facing this bull-like giant, they didn't dare let their guard down. "Get up!" Even though Jack didn't know why the police were after him, he cooperatively raised his hands. Soon he was taken to the town's police station. Just as Jack was puzzled, Officer Rose demanded he come over and register properly, or else she wouldn't be nice to him. Who knows where she got the courage, but after a thorough search, aside from a passport, Jack only had some cash and a French WWII medal on him. "What the hell are you doing in town? Don't want to talk?" The old cop was about to lock him up when a well-dressed detective walked over, saying he would personally handle this case, and then led Jack into the conference room. From the detective, he learned that last night near the highway overpass, a murder had occurred. The victim was shot at close range in the back of the head with two 9mm 95-grain bullets. The killer not only took the shell casings from the scene but also beat the victim's body, covered it with broken cardboard, and then left. This morning, someone happened to see Jack near the body dump site. Combined with his suspicious identity as a newcomer to town, he naturally became the police's prime suspect. Only then did Jack learn the truth about his arrest. "I haven't killed anyone recently, at least not in town." After understanding the case, Jack immediately concluded that three people were involved. "Three people were involved in dumping the body. The shooter is familiar with firearms—small caliber bullets, 9mm 95-grain, that's subsonic ammunition, used with a silencer. He's professional, so he picked up the shell casings. This isn't a novice. They knew how to kill efficiently and silently." Jack continued, "The second killer is a mentally deranged psychopath, because only that kind of person would beat a corpse, and this psychopath isn't rational enough to think of covering the body. The third guy is a coward who casually covered the body with waste cardboard for psychological comfort, hoping the body wouldn't be discovered." But even though Jack's analysis was flawless, it still didn't explain why he appeared near the dump site. "Jack stated that the bus doesn't stop in town, so I had to get off early and walk here. As for my purpose in coming to town, I just wanted to learn about a blues singer who died here. I like music." The detective didn't believe his explanation at all. "You have no phone, no luggage, only two hundred dollars and a French medal on you, and you traveled 800 kilometers. Do you think I'm an idiot?" They also found a phone number in the victim's shoe—229-474-3308—with the word "gather" written on it. Maybe this phone number is yours. Until they confirmed the phone number's owner, Jack was temporarily detained. But what puzzled the police was that they couldn't find any information about Jack online, not even a social media account. They only found that his parents were dead and he had a retired brother. Officer Rose was interested in this mysterious giant, so she kindly handed him a cup of coffee and comforted him not to worry—if he didn't do it, he'd be released soon. Then the detective came out, saying there was a lead on the phone number. The number belonged to a banker named Paul, who had no criminal record. Initially, he was quite calm, but when he saw a black sedan parked outside, he immediately panicked and confessed. "I did it." Faced with Paul's drastic change, the detective felt suspicious because he couldn't even name the victim or the dump site, just kept saying he did it. Paul was likely being thrown out as a scapegoat. description: type: Video Browsing; caption: Man uses his superb skills to build his own shelter with red bricks Episode 1 #wilderness building #outdoor construction #stress relief ASMR; ocr: Wilderness Construction. Full Version. Episode 1: Rapidly Transporting Large Amounts of Loess in the Wild.; asr: I've never seen such an incredible man. With his own hands, he fired over a thousand red bricks and built an impressive red brick cottage in the wilderness in just three days. Not only does it have a warm and grand clay fireplace, but he also made a fishing rod from natural branches and caught fish - those enviable wild carp. His life is simply too comfortable. Since the shelter he built before was too cramped, making it difficult for Bei to even turn over, he had no choice but to pack his backpack and set off again to find a new location for building a shelter in the wilderness. Considering that water is the most important thing for living in the wild, Bei stopped at the base of a waterfall. Not only is there an endless supply of fresh water here, but there are also small fish in the pond to eat. It's quite suitable for building a shelter. Bei then put down his beloved backpack and first properly sharpened the tools he brought. To build a shelter in the wilderness that can last a thousand years, the first requirement is a level foundation. For this, Bei first cut down the tree shade blocking the sunlight so he could clearly see the general terrain nearby. After clearing away the obstructing debris, Bei hurriedly began building the shelter. He originally wanted to remove all the obstructing boulders, but the rocks here were too hard. Even after Bei switched to a chisel and worked for two and a half hours, he only managed to flatten the top of the boulder. To give his new home a sufficiently level foundation, Bei could only collect larger stones from the stream and manually pile them up to form the base of his new home. Considering that a reliable foundation requires mortar assistance, Bei collected a large amount of clay from the wilderness. After transporting it back to camp, he mixed it with mountain spring water from 1982 to create pure natural wilderness concrete. Then Bei applied the mixed clay on top of the boulders, then took the previously collected stones and stacked them layer by layer, utilizing the stability of clay combined with stones to build a retaining wall for the foundation of his new home. After piling up the base of the new home with stones, the uneven foundation pit inside still needed to be filled with soil. To move into the new home built by the novice as soon as possible, Bei put on his pink little sack and quickly hauled large amounts of yellow soil from the wilderness. It's said that this yellow soil is very expensive - one jin per 500 grams locally. After filling the interior of the foundation pit with soil, Bei fetched a wooden stake from a distance and continuously pounded it with the strength of his arms to achieve unprecedented levelness of the ground. Considering that the shelters built before were never sturdy enough, Bei decided to design a solid exterior wall. He first found a fallen tree trunk in the wilderness, then used a wood saw to cut out a section of the trunk. After giving it a bark removal treatment, he could then create a mold for firing bricks. He just needed to cut the log into boards of consistent thickness, then drive wooden pegs into the joints to secure them. Now that he had handy tools, Bei quickly began making bricks. He simply filled the mold with the mixed clay, used a scraper to remove the excess, and after demolding, obtained square earth bricks. Bei made several dozen in one go. The next day, after the clay dried, he could begin building the brick kiln. Although the whole process looked simple, it actually tested the builder's physical strength considerably. Fortunately, Bei is 28 this year with thirty years of wilderness experience. In just two and a half hours, Bei not only completed the main structure of the brick kiln but also pre-installed the smoke exhaust pipes. Clearly, this guy has at least five years of experience in masonry work. As the door for firing red bricks was reserved, the brick kiln successfully reached the roofing stage. Bei carried his saw into the wilderness and specially collected these straight and sturdy tree trunks. Although there are many difficulties in the wilderness, as long as you're willing to endure hardship, there will be endless hardship to endure. After transporting the collected logs back to camp, he could begin completing the kiln roof. Bei used his eyes to measure the required length, then quickly started cutting with the saw. The cut logs were arranged in sequence on the wall and clay was applied accordingly, until it was as smooth as a mirror. The main purpose of doing this was to make it look good; it's not very practical. The summer sun was like a blazing fireball, but it didn't stop Bei's construction progress. name: #TruckDriver #TireWear #TruckWheelAlignment #FreightDriver
description: type: Video Browsing; caption: #TruckDriver #TireWear #TruckWheelAlignment #FreightDriver; ocr: Is wheel alignment needed for this tire wear issue on the trailer? How to fix it? This is very common on trailers, might as well just replace both the rim and tire together.; asr: Why would you do an alignment for this? This has nothing to do with alignment. Look at the edge of this tire - it's all wavy, full of dips. Look at the top of this tire, it's obvious - these bumps are all worn down. Just this spot here, worn at an angle, and this spot too. Ah, here and there, there's one down here too, and another one here. If it were an alignment issue, the tire would wear evenly all around. This patchy wear like this has absolutely nothing to do with alignment. So what's actually causing this tire wear? It's because the rim is deformed. When the wheel rolls forward normally, if the rim is deformed, it wobbles back and forth. Just this one wheel wobbling back and forth can cause these individual spots on the tread to wear down at an angle like this. This kind of wear is really common on trailers. It's fine though - just keep an eye on the tire. If you notice these signs early, quickly change the rim and the tire can still be used, no problem. But if you discover it late, like his situation now, then there's no point changing just the rim - the tire is shot. Just replace both the rim and tire together and be done with it.; actions: type: watch, play_duration: 57, played_loop_cnt: 0, is_complete_play: True, is_fast_forward_play: True, is_backward_play: True, is_enlarge_play: False

Just drop the link and go for it.; asr: Good news everyone, family members, the moment has come - my dad has finally been admitted to the hospital. After this surgery, the unbearable days will finally be over. How are you doing? Our whole family is very excited about this hospitalization. Before admission, my dad specially went to the most high-end barbershop in town to get his hair cut short, to avoid the unbearable itchy scalp when he can't wash his hair after surgery. The day before surgery, I took my dad out for a big meal to nourish his body. "You're having surgery tomorrow, so tonight I'll take you to build up your strength - I'll take you to KFC." "How about that? Let's ride bikes there. Ride bikes? Why aren't there any shared bikes around here?" "Come on, we're at KFC. Hurry up and eat." After eating and drinking our fill, I arranged for my dad to see the international superstar Jackie Chan, while I went to the most luxurious internet cafe to splurge, but ended up getting ripped off - 45 yuan for one car. Love you. A year ago, my dad was hit by a car and has suffered from the aftereffects of bone fractures. Whenever it rains or gets cloudy, his bones hurt like fire. When squatting, he can't enjoy it like before. This hospital visit is to remove the steel plate from his bones. Now regarding the surgery summary - appearance doesn't matter, health is what counts. Surgery is all about health in the end. It's still yourself, but to summarize why you got hit by a car - you can't blame others, it's just bad luck. Your fortune wasn't strong at that moment. You just arrived not long ago, right? This way, when the weather changes, you can be a weather forecast. Around 10 AM, my old father entered the operating room. Less than an hour later, I saw my dad lying on a gurney being pushed out by a nurse. "My hand speed - this is like laser work. Just like welding, sizzle, done. Some screws need to be tightened hard, just like cattle surgery." At this time, my dad wasn't fully awake yet, and phone calls started bombarding him. "Shake your legs, hello, another call coming in, no, um, lobster." "Hey, is anyone at that place? Later we'll get a red cloth strip - this is China's traditional custom since ancient times." "Who knows, I have a cow at home, what's it doing to me? How is that cow doing? Not hungry, not hungry, don't know, don't want me to go out to eat." "What are you wearing out?" "When he comes, how can he live? Really underestimated. He's really good. Then you call him big." "Working now, pour me some water, hey." "This way my mouth won't be dry. This mouth isn't full, I'm just thirsty, thirsty, thirsty. They won't let you drink water, you can just moisten it. This won't quench your thirst." "You have to rely on your own willpower. Keep it up." Alright, after my parents fully recovered, they could finally eat and drink normally. My mom took out her treasured flatbread to replenish my dad's energy, but my dad didn't appreciate it and spat out the food in his mouth. During the days accompanying my dad, after my mom went back to work, I was left alone to watch over my dad. Everyone needs their own life, and I'm no exception, so I let my dad take care of himself. "I'll put on a horror movie for you. This film is called 'Red Wedding Dress.' Watch your social media to keep from getting drowsy. When your IV is done, you'll know yourself. Keep an eye on it yourself. When it's time to change the dressing, just press the call button for the nurse. I'm going out for a bit. Okay, bye." "You can tell just by looking, alright, I'm leaving." After wandering around outside, the uncle next door asked me for help, saying their room was too boring and asking me to help fix their TV. "Awesome or what? You're amazing, you're amazing." "I'm leaving, I'm going back. He's leaving. Lei Feng, why don't you give me 500 yuan for return postage?" My dad's wound recovered quite well, and he could finally be discharged and go home. As soon as we got home, my dad couldn't wait to rush to the cattle pen. Who knew the cattle farmer was just faking - the calf had already been safely born. In the following days, my dad felt he was fine again and made several house calls. On the way, we passed by our hometown's corn factory. Since the broadcast started, everyone's corn has been selling well. So I thought I'd do a surprise inspection to see what they're busy with at the factory now. As soon as I entered the factory, I saw many aunties working under the scorching sun, busy unloading corn from the trucks. My first and second apprentices climbed onto the truck roof to help unload a lot of corn. The first batch of corn is so fresh. I randomly opened a few ears, and they all looked excellent. Since I hadn't eaten lunch, I directly took an ear of corn
